reference_supplements.assumptions: Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow with gamma=1.4 in [0,3]×[0,1] excluding the solid step x>=.6,y<.2. Compare the pre-collapse shock entering stationary zero-pressure upstream gas with a semi-analytic reference. This is not 2D Cartesian or post-collapse evolution.

caption.ja: 調和振動子BAOABの刻み0.4/0.2/0.1。離散定常共分散の偏り、有限標本誤差、正準CDF誤差とlag2の位置相関を保存値から分離表示。

caption.ja: 周期Fourierモードの線形反応拡散。16/32/64格子の連続解誤差と、固定格子での半離散厳密解に対する時間誤差を分けた保存収束図。

caption.ja: 中性立方セルの非対称8点電荷。Ewaldの実空間・逆空間打切りに対する力の差を保存値から表示。smooth PMEの格子・Bスプライン次数比較は同じ問題の補助例へ接続。

caption.en: Stored potential/field errors for 128 fixed-seed particles with a 2D free-space log kernel: FMM orders 2/4/8/12 versus a separate all-pairs sum.

caption.ja: 1次元周期・振幅0.001の冷たい電子プラズマ。CIC静電PICの変位モードとcos(t)、別々の格子・時間刻み走査の保存誤差を表示。

caption.ja: 等質なMaxwell分子の衝突成分。512/2048/8192粒子・16seedの保存モーメント誤差・標本不確かさと、物理時刻ではない衝突roundごとの異方性緩和。

caption.ja: 光学的厚さ0.7の純吸収平板。32〜512セルのBeer–Lambert参照への空間誤差と、厳密セル内伝播を使う4〜32方向の角度誤差を分けた保存図。
caption.en: Pure-absorption slab of optical depth 0.7: stored 32–512-cell spatial errors versus Beer–Lambert and a separate 4–32-ordinate angular sweep using exact cell propagation.

caption.ja: 弱い四次ポテンシャルを持つ2自由度で、CSVRとLangevinの分布・温度とエネルギーの揺らぎ・相関を比較。正準分布を独立なBoltzmann求積から得ます。
caption.en: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

caption.ja: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。
caption.en: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration.

assumptions: The problem is q_t+a q_x=0 with constant real a on a uniform grid.
The fully discrete difference_step uses forward Euler and switches between backward and forward differences according to the sign of C=a Δt/Δx.
For this linear periodic update, use |C|≤1 for stability and monotonicity. finite_difference alone is a spatial operator and does not specify a time integrator.
assumptions_ja: 対象はq_t+a q_x=0、一定の実速度a、一様格子である。
公開の完全離散更新difference_stepは前進Eulerで、C=a Δt/Δxの符号に応じて後退差分と前進差分を切り替える。
この線形周期更新の安定性・単調性には|C|≤1を用いる。finite_difference単独は空間演算子であり時間積分法を指定しない。
upwind.units: q may have any consistent unit; x is length, t is time, and a is length/time. C=a Δt/Δx is dimensionless. Released periodic benchmarks are nondimensional.
upwind.units_ja: qの単位は任意だが一貫させる。xは長さ、tは時間、aは長さ/時間で、C=a Δt/Δxは無次元。公開の周期ベンチマークは無次元化されている。
upwind.boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries are imposed with np.roll. Inflow, outflow and wall boundaries require a separate ghost-state implementation.
upwind.boundary_conditions_ja: np.rollによる周期境界。流入・流出や壁境界を扱うにはゴースト値の実装が別途必要で、現在の周期演算子をそのまま転用しない。

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws on a uniform Cartesian grid with a model-compatible numerical flux.
Euler assumes a perfect gas and positive density/pressure; HLLC and other Euler fluxes are available. Shallow-water and isothermal models require HLL or Rusanov in this solver.
solve(...,method='godunov') sets reconstruction slopes to zero and advances with SSPRK(3,3). Initial data are sampled at grid locations and used as cell values.
The released solver requires 0<CFL≤0.5; this bound alone is not a positivity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子上の双曲型保存則で、各方程式に整合する流束を選ぶ。
Eulerでは理想気体、正の密度・圧力を前提とし、HLLC等を選べる。浅水・等温モデルにはHLLまたはRusanovを選ぶ。
公開solve(...,method='godunov')は傾きを0にし、SSPRK(3,3)で時間積分する。初期値は格子点でのサンプルをセル値として与える。
公開solverが受け付けるCFLは0<CFL≤0.5。この上限だけで任意の入力の正値性を保証するものではない。
godunov.units: Use units consistent with each model's conserved variables and fluxes. Euler uses density ρ, momentum density ρu and total energy density E; each flux has its conserved-variable unit times length/time. Released shock tubes are nondimensional.
godunov.units_ja: 方程式ごとの保存変数と流束に一貫した単位を使う。Eulerでは密度ρ、運動量密度ρu、全エネルギー密度Eで、流束の単位は各保存量×長さ/時間。公開衝撃波管は無次元。
godunov.boundary_conditions: The released _pad supplies periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states, or edge extrapolation. Extrapolation is not an exact nonreflecting condition; reflecting walls and general inflow conditions are not implemented. Boundary fluxes contribute to global balances on nonperiodic domains.
godunov.boundary_conditions_ja: 公開_padは周期、端点初期値固定、または端値の外挿でゴースト値を作る。外挿は厳密な無反射条件ではなく、反射壁や一般の流入条件は実装していない。非周期領域の総量変化には境界流束が入る。

assumptions: Approximate constant-coefficient −Δu=f by continuous P1 Galerkin elements: uniform intervals on [0,1] or affine triangles from diagonally split unit-square cells.
Element formulas assemble stiffness and consistent mass; forcing uses four-point Gauss quadrature in 1D and product Gauss quadrature under a Duffy transform on triangles.
Dirichlet rows/columns are symmetrically eliminated and the system is solved by ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES; smooth manufactured solutions support L2/H1 error evaluation.
assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f を連続P1 Galerkin空間で近似する。1次元は [0,1] の一様区間、2次元は単位正方形を対角分割したアフィン三角形。
剛性・整合質量行列は要素公式を使う。右辺は1次元4点Gauss求積、三角形はDuffy変換の積Gauss求積で評価する。
Dirichletの行と列を対称に消去し、ILU(0)付きGMRESで解く。滑らかな製造解のL2/H1誤差評価を備える。
p1-fem.units: Examples use dimensionless unit-length domains. With physical scaling, [f]=[u]/L²; stiffness and mass have geometric scales L^(d−2) and L^d in dimension d.
p1-fem.units_ja: 公開例は無次元の長さ1の領域。物理尺度を付けるなら [f]=[u]/L²、次元dの剛性行列はL^(d−2)、質量行列はL^dの幾何学的尺度を持つ。
p1-fem.boundary_conditions: Dirichlet data apply at both interval endpoints or the full unit-square perimeter; defaults are zero and callbacks allow nonzero data. This example does not assemble Neumann/Robin boundary integrals.
p1-fem.boundary_conditions_ja: 区間の両端、または単位正方形の全外周にDirichlet値を指定する。標準値は零で、関数により非零値も指定できる。Neumann/Robin境界積分は本例では組み立てない。

assumptions: Left/right states are perfect-gas Euler variables (ρ,ρu,E), finite with ρ>0 and p>0, using a physical γ>1.
Outer speeds are S_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R) and S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R); the contact speed and two star states are computed algebraically.
HLLC supplies an interface flux. Reconstruction, time integration, CFL control and boundary states are provided by the caller.
The local HLLC branch accepts Euler only; availability of HLL for another model does not make this HLLC implementation applicable to it.
assumptions_ja: 左右状態は理想気体Eulerの(ρ,ρu,E)、有限かつρ>0、p>0で、物理的な比熱比γ>1を使う。
外側波速はS_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R)、S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R)。接触速度と左右star状態を代数的に計算する。
HLLCは界面流束であり、再構成、時間積分、CFLと境界状態は呼び出し側が与える。
本実装のHLLC分岐はEuler専用であり、HLLを使える他のモデルにも自動適用できるわけではない。
hllc.units: Use one consistent unit system on both sides. ρ is density, u, c and wave speeds are length/time, and p and E are energy/volume. Numerical fluxes have conserved-variable units times length/time. γ is dimensionless; released examples are nondimensional.
hllc.units_ja: 左右で同じ単位系を使う。ρは密度、uとcと各波速は長さ/時間、pとEはエネルギー/体積。数値流束は保存量×長さ/時間の単位を持つ。γは無次元で、公開例も無次元。
hllc.boundary_conditions: Physical boundary conditions do not belong to the interface-flux function. The caller constructs left/right states; the existing one-dimensional solver uses periodic, fixed-initial-endpoint or extrapolated-edge states.
hllc.boundary_conditions_ja: 界面流束そのものには物理境界条件を指定しない。呼び出し元が左右状態を作る。既存1次元solverは周期・端点初期値固定・端値外挿を用いる。

problem.ja: セル界面の左右Euler状態から、接触波を含む近似保存流束を求める。
problem.en: Compute a contact-resolving approximate conservative flux from left/right Euler states.

assumptions: The target is an ODE y'=f(t,y) represented by a real one-dimensional array, with a consistent Jacobian ∂f/∂y supplied by the caller.
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]], b=(1−γ,γ), c=(γ,1), and γ=1−1/√2. This stiffly accurate form returns the last stage.
With exact stage solves, R(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2. This γ gives A-stability and R→0 as |z|→∞ in the left half-plane.

Newton convergence is required at each stage. Distinguish fixed-step integrate from adaptive_sdirk2, which estimates error from (two half steps−one full step)/3 and accepts the two-half-step solution.
assumptions_ja: 対象は実数の1次元配列で表すODE y'=f(t,y)。整合するJacobian ∂f/∂yを呼び出し側が与える。
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]]、b=(1−γ,γ)、c=(γ,1)、γ=1−1/√2。最終段を次の解にするstiffly accurate版。
正確な段階解に対する安定関数はR(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2。このγではA安定かつ左半平面で|z|→∞のときR→0となる。
実装では各段階のNewton収束が必要。固定刻みintegrateと、(2半歩−1全歩)/3を使って2半歩の解を採用するadaptive_sdirk2を区別する。
sdirk2.units: h has time units, f_i has y_i/time, and J_ij has y_i/(y_j×time). Nondimensionalization or component scaling is needed: the fixed Newton tolerance 2×10^-12 does not automatically adapt to arbitrary physical units. Adaptive atol sets state scales and rtol is dimensionless.
sdirk2.units_ja: hは時間、f_iはy_i/時間、Jacobian要素J_ijはy_i/(y_j×時間)。無次元化または成分尺度の調整が必要で、固定のNewton許容値2×10^-12は任意の物理単位に自動対応しない。適応版のatolは状態尺度、rtolは無次元。
sdirk2.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundaries do not apply to the ODE time step itself. For semidiscrete PDEs, incorporate boundary conditions and their time dependence consistently into the RHS and Jacobian.
sdirk2.boundary_conditions_ja: ODE時間積分単体には空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEの半離散系に使う場合、境界条件とその時刻依存性を右辺とJacobianへ整合して組み込む。

assumptions: The released example is an autonomous separable one-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q) with unit mass and V=q²/2 or q²/2+q⁴/4.
The force is −V'(q), depending only on position. The update is p_half=p−h V'(q)/2, q_new=q+h p_half, p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2.
Reversibility and symplecticity refer to the same fixed-step map. Dynamical time scales must still be resolved for accuracy and stability.
assumptions_ja: 公開例は1自由度、単位質量の自律・分離Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q)。V=q²/2またはq²/2+q⁴/4。
力は−V'(q)で位置のみに依存する。p_half=p−h V'(q)/2、q_new=q+h p_half、p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2を用いる。
可逆性とシンプレクティック性の説明は固定刻みの同じ写像に対するもの。精度と安定性のため力学的時間尺度を解像する。

assumptions: Constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square interior grid with n=2^k−1 per axis.
Coarse operators are rediscretized five-point operators; restriction is full weighting, prolongation bilinear, with three red-black Gauss–Seidel pre/post sweeps by default.
The one-unknown coarsest problem is solved exactly. Entry points use either mixed absolute/relative residual stopping or the comparison's true relative residual.
assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f、正方形の一様内部格子、各軸 n=2^k−1 の入れ子格子を仮定する。
粗格子作用素は五点差分の再離散化。full weighting制限、双線形補間、red-black Gauss–Seidelの前後各3回平滑化を標準とする。
最粗格子1未知数は厳密に解く。停止判定は公開入口により絶対値を併用した残差または共通比較用の真の相対残差。

assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
assumptions_ja: FとJacobianを利用者が与える。平方の微分可能な系と、解の近くで非特異なJacobianが基本となる。
長さ1から1/2ずつ減らし、||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂ を要求する。α<2⁻²⁰で失敗を返す。
GMRES経路でもJacobianは明示的に与える。CSRならILU(0)、それ以外ならJacobi前処理を使い、内部残差と外部絶対残差を区別する。
newton.units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.

assumptions: A cubic periodic box, positive finite particle masses, finite positions, cubic n³ mesh with n≥4 and L>0; coordinates wrap modulo L in every axis.
CIC deposits to eight vertices with product-linear weights divided by cell volume; interpolation uses the same weights. No CIC-window deconvolution is applied.
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−meanρ), with φ̂(0)=0. Nonzero modes use −4πG/k² and acceleration is −∇φ. On even meshes, each derivative zeroes its own-axis Nyquist mode to retain a real odd operator.
assumptions_ja: 立方体の周期箱、正かつ有限の粒子質量、有限位置、立方n³格子でn≥4、L>0を使う。位置は各軸でLを法として折り返す。
CICは8隅への積線形重みで密度を作り、格子体積で割る。粒子へ戻す補間も同じ重み。CIC窓の逆補正は行わない。
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−平均ρ)、φ̂(0)=0。非零モードは −4πG/k²、加速度は−∇φ。偶数格子の微分は各軸の対応Nyquistモードを零にして実の奇作用素を保つ。
pm.units: pm_acceleration is a dimensionless G=1 example. L and positions share a length unit; density, potential and acceleration scale as M/L³, GM/L and GM/L². Only the lower-level periodic_poisson accepts a positive gravity parameter.
pm.units_ja: pm_accelerationはG=1固定の無次元例。L・位置には同じ長さ単位を使い、ρは質量/L³、φはGM/L、加速度はGM/L²に対応する。下位関数periodic_poissonのみ正のgravityを指定できる。
pm.boundary_conditions: Periodic in all directions with box length L. Mean removal enforces periodic-Poisson compatibility, while zeroing k=0 fixes the additive potential gauge. This is not the isolated-force problem.
pm.boundary_conditions_ja: 全方向周期、箱長L。平均密度を除くことで周期Poissonの整合性を満たし、k=0を零に固定してポテンシャルの加法定数を選ぶ。孤立境界の力とは同一問題でない。

assumptions: Positions are finite (N,3), masses positive and finite, and N≥1; ε=softening>0, theta≥0 and order is 0 or 2.
A node is accepted when s/d<theta, with s=2×half and d measured to its center of mass. Target-containing cells are always opened; leaves exclude self terms.
The acceleration kernel is −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2). order=2 adds the full Taylor term from S=Σmδδᵀ, retaining trace(S) for the softened kernel.
assumptions_ja: 位置は有限の(N,3)配列、質量は正かつ有限、粒子数は1以上。softening=ε>0、theta≥0、orderは0または2。
節点の一辺s=2×half、質量中心までの距離dについて s/d<theta なら受理する。ただし対象粒子を含むセルは必ず開き、葉では自己項を除く。
加速度核は −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2)。order=2はS=Σmδδᵀの完全なTaylor項を加え、軟化された核に必要なtrace(S)項も保持する。
barnes-hut.units: Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
barnes-hut.units_ja: 無次元のG=1。位置と軟化長は同じ長さ単位、質量には一貫した単位を使う。長さL₀・質量M₀で次元を戻す場合、加速度の尺度はGM₀/L₀²。
barnes-hut.boundary_conditions: Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.
barnes-hut.boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立境界で周期像を加えない。軟化核のポテンシャル −Gm/√(r²+ε²) は無限遠で零となる規約。周期PM・Ewald・TreePMとは異なる境界問題。

assumptions: The reference interval is [−1,1] with weight one: ∫PⱼPₖdξ=2δⱼₖ/(2k+1); orthonormal=True multiplies by √((2k+1)/2).
Degree is a nonnegative integer. project_legendre approximates projection integrals by Gauss quadrature, leaving quadrature error for general functions.
Exact element-matrix quadrature means p+1 Gauss points for polynomial products with constant coefficients and an affine map.
assumptions_ja: 参照区間 [−1,1]、重み1の内積を採用する。∫PⱼPₖdξ=2δⱼₖ/(2k+1)、orthonormal指定時は√((2k+1)/2)を掛ける。
degreeは0以上の整数。project_legendreはGauss求積で射影積分を近似するため、一般関数に対して求積誤差も残る。
element_matricesの厳密求積指定は定係数・アフィン写像下の多項式積を対象とし、p+1点Gaussを使う。
legendre-basis.units: ξ and basis values are dimensionless. On an affine interval of length L, J=L/2 scales mass by J and gradient stiffness by 1/J. Expansion coefficients share the represented function's units.
legendre-basis.units_ja: ξと基底は無次元。長さLのアフィン区間ではJ=L/2で、質量行列にJ、勾配の剛性行列に1/Jを掛ける。展開係数は表す関数と同じ単位。
legendre-basis.boundary_conditions: Basis evaluation/projection imposes no physical boundary condition. Endpoint values/fluxes and interelement coupling belong to the consuming discretization; the constant stiffness nullspace is not removed automatically.
legendre-basis.boundary_conditions_ja: 基底の評価・射影自体は物理境界を課さない。端点の値や流束、隣接要素の接続は利用する離散化側が指定する。剛性行列の定数モードの零空間も自動で除かない。

assumptions: Interval nodes must be distinct finite real values at modest degree; cardinal polynomials are evaluated through a Legendre Vandermonde solve.
For p≥1, GLL nodes are ±1 and roots of Pₚ′. A p+1-point GLL rule is exact through degree 2p−1, not generally for degree-2p mass products.
Triangle functions are only P1/P2 on (0,0),(1,0),(0,1). Quadrilaterals use Qₚ tensor products with (p+1)² degrees of freedom.
assumptions_ja: 区間節点は相異なる有限実数で、中程度の次数を想定する。区間のLagrange多項式はLegendre Vandermonde行列を解いて評価する。
p≥1のGLL節点は両端±1とPₚ′の根。p+1点GLL求積は2p−1次まで厳密で、次数2pの質量積分は一般には厳密でない。
三角形は (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) のP1またはP2のみ。四角形は区間基底のQₚ積で、自由度数は(p+1)²。
nodal-basis.units: Reference coordinates/basis values are dimensionless; nodal values carry the function's units. Affine interval matrices scale as M∝J and K∝1/J with J=L/2.
nodal-basis.units_ja: 参照座標と基底は無次元、節点値は表す関数の単位。アフィン区間行列はJ=L/2により M∝J、K∝1/J。
nodal-basis.boundary_conditions: GLL includes endpoints but does not itself enforce Dirichlet values or interelement continuity. The consuming discretization supplies values, fluxes and coupling.
nodal-basis.boundary_conditions_ja: GLLは端点を含むが、それだけでDirichlet値や要素間の連続性を課すわけではない。境界値・流束・接続は利用側が指定する。

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional perfect-gas Euler on a uniform Cartesian grid, with finite positive density and pressure at each stage.
q contains point values, not cell averages. A global a=max|u±c| splits f±=(f±a q)/2; oppositely biased five-point stencils reconstruct the two fluxes.
Weights use d=(0.1,0.6,0.3), Jiang–Shu β_k, τ_5=|β_0−β_2| and α_k=d_k[1+(τ_5/(ε+β_k))²], with default ε=10^-6.
Both split fluxes use the same face-frozen Roe characteristic basis by default; component reconstruction is optional. Time integration is SSPRK(3,3), with 0<CFL≤0.5.
assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子の理想気体Eulerで、各段階に有限かつ正の密度・圧力を要する。
qはセル平均ではなく点値。大域波速a=max|u±c|でf±=(f±a q)/2に分け、正負の流束に逆向きの5点ステンシルを使う。
既定は界面で固定したRoe特性基底で両流束を投影し、成分別も選べる。時間積分はSSPRK(3,3)、入力CFLは0<CFL≤0.5。
weno-z.units: Released Euler examples are nondimensional. With dimensional data, β and τ scale as the squared projected flux, so the effect of a fixed ε=10^-6 changes with scaling. Nondimensionalize states/fluxes or choose a scale-consistent ε. Use compatible units for Δt, Δx and wave speed.
weno-z.units_ja: 公開例は無次元Euler量。一般の単位を使う場合、βとτは投影した流束の2乗の尺度を持つため、固定ε=10^-6の効果も変わる。状態・流束の無次元化または尺度に合うεを検討する。Δt・Δx・波速の単位は整合させる。
weno-z.boundary_conditions: reconstruction._pad uses periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states or edge extrapolation. Uniform high-order boundary accuracy and nonreflection are not guaranteed.
weno-z.boundary_conditions_ja: reconstruction._padで周期、端点初期値固定、または端値外挿のゴースト値を使う。境界での一様な高次精度や無反射性は保証しない。

assumptions: One electron in the Coulomb potential -Z/r of an isolated, infinite-mass point nucleus; nonrelativistic and field-free.
Separate angular momentum l and solve for the reduced radial orbital u(r), normalized by integral |u|^2 dr=1.
Released inputs use Z=1,2 and (n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2); these cases do not cover arbitrary many-electron states.
A uniform interior radial grid and a real symmetric tridiagonal second-order kinetic operator are used.
assumptions_ja: 孤立・無限質量の点核によるCoulomb場−Z/r中の1電子。非相対論・外場なし。
角運動量lを分離し、∫|u|²dr=1で規格化した縮約動径軌道u(r)を解く。
公開入力はZ=1,2および(n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2)。任意の多電子状態を検証したものではない。
一様な内部動径格子と、2次の運動エネルギー差分による実対称三重対角行列を用いる。
schrodinger.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2).

schrodinger.boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0. Released hydrogenic refinement inputs use r_max=60 bohr; a separate Z=1 1s study uses r_max=4,8,16,32 bohr. Origin and infinity are approximated by regularity and finite-box Dirichlet conditions.
schrodinger.boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(r_max)=0。公開する水素型の格子検査はr_max=60 bohr。Z=1の1sは別途r_max=4,8,16,32 bohrを比較。原点の正則性と無限遠の減衰を有限箱のDirichlet条件で近似する。

variant.en: Angular-momentum-separated reduced radial equation, second-order central differences and a tridiagonal eigensolver, referenced to E_n=-Z^2/(2n^2) and analytic orbitals.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Born–Oppenheimer, nonrelativistic isolated H2 closed-shell RHF, two electrons.

assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：Born–Oppenheimer・非相対論・孤立H₂、2電子の閉殻RHF。

electronic-bases.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.

electronic-bases.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: Isolated finite molecule; analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals with no finite spatial box. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

assumptions: Atomic branch: Nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2, an infinite-mass point nucleus and two opposite-spin electrons occupying the same spherical 1s spatial orbital.
Atomic branch: Normalize integral |u|^2 dr=1 and define p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n, so integral p dr=2.
Atomic branch: For this occupied orbital only, the Fock equation reduces to the effective field -2/r+v_H/2 and E_x=-E_H/2; no general nonlocal Fock operator is implemented.
Atomic branch: Single-determinant exchange is included; electron correlation is omitted.
Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.
assumptions_ja: 従来の原子例：Z=2の孤立He、無限質量の点核、非相対論。逆スピンの2電子が同じ球対称1s空間軌道を占有する。
従来の原子例：∫|u|²dr=1とし、p=2|u|²=4πr²n、∫p dr=2と定義する。
従来の原子例：この占有軌道に限り有効場は−2/r+v_H/2、交換エネルギーはE_x=−E_H/2に簡約される。一般の非局所Fock演算子は実装していない。
従来の原子例：単一行列式の交換を含み、電子相関を含まない。
別の分子例：H₂の有限s型Gaussian基底RHF。自作の1・2電子積分と行列SCFを用い、公差・収束はH₂入力と検証結果で確認する。
hartree-fock.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.
hartree-fock.units_ja: 原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。正の電子数密度n(r)はbohr⁻³、動径電子数密度p(r)=4πr²n(r)はbohr⁻¹、∫p dr=N。pは符号付き電荷密度ではありません。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。
hartree-fock.boundary_conditions: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.
hartree-fock.boundary_conditions_ja: He縮約軌道にu(0)=u(r_max)=0（基本r_max=16 bohr、別途4/8/12/16 bohrの領域検査）。Hartree場は原点で有限、密度の外ではN/rへ接続し、r_maxで0には固定しません。 別のH₂側は孤立分子の全空間Gaussian解析積分で、有限の動径箱は設けない。

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The fixed-point map is the released spherical He 1s² HF or exchange-only LDA radial model, not a general molecular or periodic SCF implementation.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Mix input and output radial number densities: p_next=(1-alpha)p_in+alpha p_out, 0<alpha<=1; released baseline alpha=0.35 and an alternative start uses 0.7.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Each eigenproblem normalizes u and sets p_out=2|u|^2, so the electron-number normalization is imposed within the iteration.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Convergence requires input/output density L1<1e-9 electrons, |energy change|<1e-10 hartree, and the output-density-rebuilt orbital residual<1e-7 hartree; maximum 300 iterations.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The atlas iteration implements no DIIS, Anderson or Newton acceleration. An independent PySCF reference may use its own solver algorithms.

Atomic/molecular examples: Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：固定点写像は公開する球対称He 1s²のHFまたは交換のみLDA動径モデルであり、汎用の分子・周期系SCF実装ではない。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：入力・出力の動径電子数密度をp_next=(1−α)p_in+αp_out（0<α≤1）で混合。公開基本値α=0.35、別の初期値では0.7も用いる。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：各固有値問題でuを規格化しp_out=2|u|²とするため、電子数の規格化は反復内で課している。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：密度の入出力L1差<10⁻⁹電子数、|エネルギー変化|<10⁻¹⁰hartree、出力密度で再構成した軌道残差<10⁻⁷hartreeをすべて要求。最大300反復。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：アトラス側の反復にDIIS・Anderson・Newton加速は未採用。独立PySCF参照は独自のソルバーを使いうる。
原子・分子の実行例：別の分子例：H₂の有限s型Gaussian基底RHF。自作の1・2電子積分と行列SCFを用い、公差・収束はH₂入力と検証結果で確認する。
固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
scf.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Mixing alpha and iteration number are dimensionless. Radial p is in bohr^(-1), integral |p_out-p_in| dr is electron number, and energy changes/normalized orbital residuals are in hartree. Published tolerances belong to this normalization and model. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
scf.units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：混合率αと反復回数は無次元。pはbohr⁻¹、∫|p_out−p_in|drは電子数、エネルギー変化と規格化した軌道残差はhartree。公開公差はこの規格化とモデルに対する値。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。
scf.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: SCF mixing itself imposes no spatial boundary condition. The supplied helium fixed-point map uses reduced-orbital u(0)=u(r_max)=0 and an isolated finite-origin, N/r Hartree field; see the HF/KS/Hartree records. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

Distinguish process completion from convergence, including an intentional one-iteration failure.

en: Assuming the same mixing and tolerances are generally suitable for metals, difficult systems or molecular SCF.
Using iteration termination alone to establish stability, minimum energy or physical accuracy.

assumptions: Introductory formulation and comparison, not a verified executable solver.
Representative electronic-structure formulas use nonrelativistic Born–Oppenheimer theory unless the section explicitly states otherwise.
assumptions_ja: 定式化と比較の導入解説であり、実行・検証済みソルバーではありません。
代表式は、各節に別記する場合を除き非相対論・Born–Oppenheimerの電子状態問題を想定します。
diis.units: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed.
diis.units_ja: 表示する電子状態の式は原子単位系（ℏ = m_e = e = 4πε₀ = 1）。無次元量や占有の規約は各節に明記。
diis.boundary_conditions: Isolated or periodic conditions must be selected for each physical system; no numerical boundary-value example is published here yet.
diis.boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・周期を対象系ごとに選ぶ必要があります。この導入には実行済みの境界値計算例はまだありません。

assumptions: A nonnegative spherically symmetric electron-number density n(r), with p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) and integral p dr=N; released helium uses N=2.
For an isolated system, v_H(r)=integral_0^R p(s)/max(r,s) ds and E_H=(1/2) integral p(r)v_H(r) dr.
The code uses uniform-grid cumulative quadrature with p=0 at the two endpoints and zero density outside the finite box; the same-radius quadrature sample is counted once.

v_H is positive electron repulsion and satisfies Laplacian(v_H)=-4 pi n in atomic units. Signed electronic charge density is -n; v_H is electron potential energy, not the electrostatic potential generated by that negative charge.
assumptions_ja: 非負・球対称の電子数密度n(r)を仮定。p(r)=4πr²n(r)、∫p dr=Nと定義し、公開He例はN=2。
孤立系のv_H(r)=∫₀ᴿp(s)/max(r,s)dsとE_H=(1/2)∫p(r)v_H(r)drを評価する。
一様格子の累積求積を用い、両端p=0、有限箱外の密度は0とする。同じ半径の求積標本を1回だけ数える。
v_Hは正の電子間反発で、原子単位系で∇²v_H=−4πn。符号付き電子電荷密度は−nであり、v_Hは負電荷が作る静電ポテンシャルそのものではなく電子のポテンシャルエネルギー。
hartree-poisson.units: Atomic units: r in bohr, n in bohr^(-3), p in bohr^(-1), N an electron number, v_H and E_H in hartree. The positive-number-density convention fixes the Poisson sign.
hartree-poisson.units_ja: 原子単位系。rはbohr、nはbohr⁻³、pはbohr⁻¹、Nは電子数、v_HとE_Hはhartree。正の電子数密度という規約とPoisson式の符号を組にする。
hartree-poisson.boundary_conditions: Isolated spherical Coulomb boundary: v_H is finite at the origin and equals N/r outside the truncated density support. It is not a zero-Dirichlet condition at r_max. Endpoint p=0 is inherited from the reduced orbital; no periodic neutrality/background convention is implemented.
hartree-poisson.boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・球対称Coulomb境界。v_Hは原点で有限、切断した密度の外側ではN/r。r_maxで0とするDirichlet条件ではない。端点p=0は縮約軌道から与え、周期系の中性化・背景電荷の規約は実装していない。

problem.ja: 与えた球対称電子数密度が作る孤立系Coulomb反発場とHartreeエネルギーを求める。
problem.en: Find the isolated repulsive Coulomb field and Hartree energy of a specified spherical electron-number density.

variant.ja: 動径密度pに対する内側・外側積分の累積求積。Poisson式は符号と境界の等価な記述で、専用PDE反復解法ではない。
variant.en: Cumulative inner/outer radial quadrature in p; Poisson's equation provides the equivalent sign/boundary interpretation, not a separate iterative PDE solver.

ja: 球対称の滑らかな電子密度でv_HとE_Hを評価する。
解析的指数密度と遠方の電子数/rでCoulomb場の符号・境界・会計を確認する。
en: Evaluate v_H and E_H for smooth spherical electron densities.
Check sign, boundaries and accounting against analytic exponential density and the N/r far field.

ja: 非球対称・周期系にこの1次元Coulomb積分をそのまま適用する。
同じ求積の標本を1回にする処理を、点電荷自己エネルギー除去や交換と混同する。
en: Applying this one-dimensional Coulomb integral directly to nonspherical or periodic systems.
Confusing quadrature sample counting with point-charge self-energy removal or exchange.

reason.en: Specified number/radial density and repulsive-potential units/sign.

reason.en: Checked finite-origin/N/r behavior, distinct from the orbital's u=0 boundaries.

reason.ja: 球対称求積、求積の対角標本、物理的自己相互作用を区別。
reason.en: Distinguished spherical quadrature, diagonal samples and physical self-interaction.

The analytic-density test is not an error guarantee for arbitrary densities/domains.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Use the total spin-unpolarized positive number density n=n_up+n_down, with n_up=n_down=n/2; in the radial example n=p/(4 pi r^2).
Atomic/molecular examples: The implemented exchange is E_x=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r and v_x=delta E_x/delta n=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), hence E_x=(3/4) integral p v_x dr.
Atomic/molecular examples: Set E_c=v_c=0 explicitly. This is not LDA plus a correlation parameterization and not Slater X-alpha with an unspecified coefficient.
Atomic/molecular examples: The public execution uses spherical closed-shell He 1s² and independently compares the same exchange-only choice against PySCF with xc='LDA_X,'.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：両スピンを合計した正の電子数密度n=n_up+n_downを用い、n_up=n_down=n/2のスピン非偏極を仮定。動径例ではn=p/(4πr²)。
原子・分子の実行例：実装はE_x=−(3/4)(3/π)¹ᐟ³∫n⁴ᐟ³d³r、v_x=δE_x/δn=−(3n/π)¹ᐟ³で、E_x=(3/4)∫p v_x dr。
原子・分子の実行例：E_c=v_c=0を明示する。相関のパラメータ化を追加したLDAでも、係数不明のSlater Xαでもない。
原子・分子の実行例：公開実行は球対称・閉殻He 1s²。独立参照もxc='LDA_X,'と指定し、同じ交換のみ近似を比較する。
固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
xc-functionals.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units: total number density n in bohr^(-3), radial p in bohr^(-1), local v_x in hartree, and integrated E_x in hartree. The energy functional and its derivative use the same density and spin convention. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
xc-functionals.units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：原子単位系。全電子数密度nはbohr⁻³、動径密度pはbohr⁻¹、局所v_xと積分したE_xはhartree。エネルギー汎関数とその微分で密度・スピンの規約をそろえる。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。
xc-functionals.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: The local exchange functional itself has no spatial boundary condition. The density/orbital problem supplies the isolated helium box and normalization. Gradient, nonlocal-exchange or periodic-functional boundaries are outside this implementation. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.
xc-functionals.boundary_conditions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：局所交換汎関数自体には空間境界条件はない。密度・軌道の問題が孤立Heの箱と規格化を与える。勾配項・非局所交換・周期系の境界処理は実装対象外。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。

problem.en: Specify approximate exchange-correlation energy and obtain a consistent effective potential in electronic-structure calculations.

variant.ja: スピン非偏極Dirac交換のみ（LDA_X）。E_c=0、p=4πr²nを介した動径積分でE_xとv_xを同時に返す。
variant.en: Spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange only (LDA_X), E_c=0; radial integration through p=4 pi r^2 n returns consistent E_x and v_x.

ja: 同じ密度・スピン規約でエネルギーと汎関数微分の整合を学ぶ。
交換のみという同一条件で独立実装と照合し、数値誤差とモデル誤差を分ける。
en: Study consistency between energy and its functional derivative under one density/spin convention.
Compare independent implementations of the same exchange-only model and separate numerical from model errors.

ja: 相関を含む汎関数、スピン分極、GGA・meta-GGA・hybridの結果が必要。

Using helium LDA_X agreement as a general functional or molecular/solid accuracy guarantee.

reason.ja: nとpを区別し、汎関数微分と全エネルギーに同じ規約を適用。
reason.en: Distinguished n/p and used one convention for the functional derivative and total energy.

reason.ja: 局所汎関数は密度を評価するだけで、空間境界はHeの軌道問題が供給。
reason.en: The local functional evaluates a supplied density; the helium orbital problem supplies boundaries.

reason.ja: 採用したLDA_Xと文献上のGGA/meta-GGA/hybridを区別。

assumptions: Smooth lower-branch Bratu states on a fixed mesh with a locally nonsingular state Jacobian and fixed zero Dirichlet data.
The new spatial coefficient is lambda(x)=a+b(2x-1), with a in [1,2.8] and b in [-0.5,0.5]; this extends the earlier constant-lambda model.
Fixed synthetic observations, positive weights and explicitly stated parameter scales, priors and regularization strengths; data-only sensitivity rank is separate from a regularized system rank.
assumptions_ja: 固定格子・固定ゼロDirichlet境界の滑らかなBratu下側分枝を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。

合成観測と正の重みを固定し、パラメータの尺度・事前値・正則化強度を明記する。データだけの感度行列の階数と、正則化後の系の階数を区別する。
optimization.units: Dimensionless state, coordinate and coefficients. Observation weights and parameter scales are explicit; singular values and regularization strengths depend on those scales.
optimization.units_ja: 状態・座標・係数は無次元。観測重みとパラメータ尺度を明記し、特異値と正則化強度の尺度依存を区別する。
optimization.boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(1)=0 independent of both coefficients; fixed observation locations on [0,1].
optimization.boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(1)=0を両係数に依存せず固定し、観測位置も区間[0,1]内で固定する。

assumptions: Smooth residual and scalar objective; locally nonsingular state Jacobian.
Fixed mesh and boundary data independent of the parameter; lower-branch Bratu at alpha=1 and alpha=2.
Converged discrete equations are differentiated; finite Newton iterations are not unrolled.
assumptions_ja: 滑らかな残差とスカラー目的関数を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。
格子と境界値はパラメータに依存しない。Bratuの下側分枝のalpha=1、2を使う。
収束した離散方程式を微分し、有限回のNewton反復は展開して微分しない。
adjoint.units: Dimensionless Bratu variables and parameter; objective quadrature h=1/(n+1) is explicit.
adjoint.units_ja: Bratuの変数とパラメータは無次元。目的関数の求積重みh=1/(n+1)を明記する。

adjoint.boundary_conditions_ja: 区間[0,1]でu(0)=u(1)=0をlambdaに依存せず固定し、境界の感度はゼロとする。

depth_scope.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。 Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。 Schnakenberg有限振幅過渡：非線形性と独立参照: t=8までの有限振幅反応拡散を、独立なFourier–Galerkin参照・格子と時間刻み収束・新しい高調波で検証します。 Schnakenberg飽和パターン：近定常性と格子・時間収束: t=100の1D選択パターンを独立参照で照合。参照の90→100の変化・全PDE残差と、有限刻みprimaryのFD残差を分けて測ります。 非周期壁面の2D渦度・流れ関数法でRe100蓋駆動キャビティと製造流れを解きます。Ghia原著の有限格子数値表、壁剪断と格子収束を比較し、独立した圧力Poisson・勾配製造問題を区別します。 追加の周期2D KH/RT初期成長は、維持した滑らかな基底と独立線形IVPを使用。中央の保存面流束とHeunで渦度/浮力を実際に進め、圧力は消去します。 追加は2Dセル中心PoissonのNeumann/Robin境界。実際の五点面流束と半セルRobin消去、適合条件・平均ゲージ・境界流束誤差を確認します。 追加は実際の2D線形回転浅水C-grid。staggered勾配・発散・随伴な4点Coriolis補間を使い、連続波と離散記号を分けて比較します。
depth_scope.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions. Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode. Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics. Near-saturated Schnakenberg pattern: near-stationarity and grid/time convergence: Compare the selected1D pattern at t=100 with an independent reference. Separate reference90→100 change/full-PDE residual from the finite-step primary FD residual. Solve a Re100 lid-driven cavity and manufactured flow with a nonperiodic wall-bounded2D vorticity/streamfunction method. Compare original finite-grid Ghia tables, wall shear and grid refinement, keeping a separate pressure-Poisson/gradient manufactured problem distinct. Additional periodic2D KH/RT initial growth uses maintained smooth bases and independent linear IVPs; actual centered conservative face fluxes and Heun evolve vorticity/buoyancy with pressure eliminated. Additional2D cell-centered Poisson uses actual five-point face differences and half-cell Robin elimination; check Neumann compatibility/mean gauge and continuous boundary-flux error. Additional actual2D linear rotating-SWE C-grid uses staggered gradients/divergence and adjoint four-point Coriolis interpolation; separate continuous and discrete-symbol references.

assumptions: The problem is q_t+a q_x=0 with constant real a on a uniform grid.
The fully discrete difference_step uses forward Euler and switches between backward and forward differences according to the sign of C=a Δt/Δx.
For this linear periodic update, use |C|≤1 for stability and monotonicity. finite_difference alone is a spatial operator and does not specify a time integrator.
legacy_method_records.units: q may have any consistent unit; x is length, t is time, and a is length/time. C=a Δt/Δx is dimensionless. Released periodic benchmarks are nondimensional.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries are imposed with np.roll. Inflow, outflow and wall boundaries require a separate ghost-state implementation.

limitations.ja: 空間・時間とも1次精度で、一般に波形や接触面を拡散させる。|C|>1ではこの陽的更新の安定性は保たれない。一定速度のスカラー例だけから、変係数・非線形系や多次元での保存性・安定性は保証しない。
limitations.en: First order in both space and time and generally diffusive for waves and contacts. The explicit periodic update is unstable for |C|>1. This constant-speed scalar example establishes no conservation or stability guarantee for variable-coefficient, nonlinear-system or multidimensional extensions.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws on a uniform Cartesian grid with a model-compatible numerical flux.
Euler assumes a perfect gas and positive density/pressure; HLLC and other Euler fluxes are available. Shallow-water and isothermal models require HLL or Rusanov in this solver.
solve(...,method='godunov') sets reconstruction slopes to zero and advances with SSPRK(3,3). Initial data are sampled at grid locations and used as cell values.
The released solver requires 0<CFL≤0.5; this bound alone is not a positivity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
legacy_method_records.units: Use units consistent with each model's conserved variables and fluxes. Euler uses density ρ, momentum density ρu and total energy density E; each flux has its conserved-variable unit times length/time. Released shock tubes are nondimensional.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: The released _pad supplies periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states, or edge extrapolation. Extrapolation is not an exact nonreflecting condition; reflecting walls and general inflow conditions are not implemented. Boundary fluxes contribute to global balances on nonperiodic domains.

limitations.ja: 空間1次なので衝撃波や接触面が広がる。原報の厳密Riemann解を用いる1段更新そのものではなく、時間3次でも全体の空間精度は1次のまま。近似流束・初期値の点サンプル・境界処理の選択に依存し、真空、乾湿境界、一般EOS、多次元および一般的な正値性・エントロピー保証は対象外。
limitations.en: First-order spatial reconstruction smears shocks and contacts. This is not the original one-step exact-Riemann algorithm, and third-order time stepping does not raise its spatial order. Results depend on the approximate flux, sampled initialization and boundary treatment. Vacuum, wet/dry fronts, general equations of state, multiple dimensions, and general positivity/entropy guarantees are outside scope.

assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子上の双曲型保存則で、各方程式に整合する流束を選ぶ。
Eulerでは理想気体、正の密度・圧力を前提とし、HLLC等を選べる。浅水・等温モデルにはHLLまたはRusanovを選ぶ。
公開solve(...,method='godunov')は傾きを0にし、SSPRK(3,3)で時間積分する。初期値は格子点でのサンプルをセル値として与える。
公開solverが受け付けるCFLは0<CFL≤0.5。この上限だけで任意の入力の正値性を保証するものではない。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 方程式ごとの保存変数と流束に一貫した単位を使う。Eulerでは密度ρ、運動量密度ρu、全エネルギー密度Eで、流束の単位は各保存量×長さ/時間。公開衝撃波管は無次元。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 公開_padは周期、端点初期値固定、または端値の外挿でゴースト値を作る。外挿は厳密な無反射条件ではなく、反射壁や一般の流入条件は実装していない。非周期領域の総量変化には境界流束が入る。

depth_scope.ja: 衝撃波と密度正弦波の相互作用を、同じPython実装の細格子ではなく、別に実行したAthena++の参照と照合します。 追加Noh版では球対称系列だけに体積重心を用いる保存量MUSCL/minmod＋Heunを実装し、平面・円筒は区分定数のままです。 低Mach渦の追加例は、両Roe流束に同じ無制限の中心primitive再構築を用います。勾配制限付きMUSCL全般やTVDの保証ではありません。 追加の二重膨張波は1次元保存量MUSCL・共有Lax–Friedrichs流束・平均を保つ正値状態スケーリング・SSPRK(3,3)を接続した限定例です。許容CFLと波速条件、各前進Euler候補・SSP段の平均と面状態、保存収支を測り、一般のEuler・WENO・DG・MHDの正値性保証へ拡張しません。 追加のZalesak型例は与えた発散ゼロ速度による2次元スカラー回転輸送です。同一の周期格子・SSPRK(3,3)で一次風上とminmod MUSCLを比較し、各段の範囲・保存量と一回転後の形状誤差を調べます。FCT法や多次元Euler全般の有界性を認証しません。 追加の全成分1D円偏波と実際の2D磁場ループ/Orszag–TangでHLLD・MC-MUSCL・Heunを使用。HLLD→HLLE代替と面の正値性スケーリングを数え、セルfloorや再試行は行いません。 追加の軽量1D SRHD対称衝突/SRMHD有限振幅円偏極波は、同じ完全7量の応力/誘導、MUSCL-minmod、因果的HLL±1、SSPRK33とZ回復を使用。一般Riemann・GR・極端速度の認証ではありません。
depth_scope.en: Compare shock–density-wave interaction against separately executed Athena++ reference data rather than a finer grid of the same Python code. The additional Noh edition uses volume-centroid conservative MUSCL/minmod with Heun only in spherical runs; planar/cylindrical states stay piecewise constant. The additional low-Mach vortex uses the same unlimited central primitive reconstruction for both Roe variants. It does not verify general limited MUSCL or a TVD guarantee. The additional double rarefaction connects one-dimensional conservative MUSCL, shared Lax–Friedrichs fluxes, mean-preserving positive-state scaling and SSPRK(3,3). Check the admissible CFL/wave-speed conditions, means and faces at each forward-Euler candidate/SSP stage, and conservation budgets; this does not certify general Euler, WENO, DG or MHD positivity. The additional Zalesak-type example is two-dimensional scalar rotation in a prescribed divergence-free velocity. Compare donor-cell upwinding and minmod MUSCL with the same periodic grid and SSPRK(3,3), measuring stage bounds, conservation and full-turn shape errors. It does not certify FCT or general multidimensional Euler bounds. Additional full-state1D CP wave and actual2D magnetic-loop/Orszag–Tang use HLLD,MC-MUSCL and Heun. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallback and face positivity scaling,with no cell floor or PDE retry. Additional lightweight1D SRHD symmetric collision/SRMHD finite-amplitude CP wave use the shared full7-variable stress/induction,MUSCL-minmod,causalHLL±1,SSPRK33 and Z recovery; no generic Riemann,GR or extreme-speed claim.

supports.ja: 三角形分割上の区分線形関数による変分近似を根拠付ける。現代的な疎行列・線形解法の出典とは区別する。
supports.en: Supports triangular piecewise-linear variational approximation, separately from the modern sparse solver implementation.

verification.locator: Section III, paragraph on linear functions on triangles, PDF p. 15 (reprint printed p. 2179); primary-paper reprint.

assumptions: Approximate constant-coefficient −Δu=f by continuous P1 Galerkin elements: uniform intervals on [0,1] or affine triangles from diagonally split unit-square cells.
Element formulas assemble stiffness and consistent mass; forcing uses four-point Gauss quadrature in 1D and product Gauss quadrature under a Duffy transform on triangles.
Dirichlet rows/columns are symmetrically eliminated and the system is solved by ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES; smooth manufactured solutions support L2/H1 error evaluation.
legacy_method_records.units: Examples use dimensionless unit-length domains. With physical scaling, [f]=[u]/L²; stiffness and mass have geometric scales L^(d−2) and L^d in dimension d.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Dirichlet data apply at both interval endpoints or the full unit-square perimeter; defaults are zero and callbacks allow nonzero data. This example does not assemble Neumann/Robin boundary integrals.

limitations.ja: 汎用メッシュ生成や曲線要素、可変係数、混合要素の実装ではない。L2で2次・H1半ノルムで1次という既存の検査は滑らかな製造解と本メッシュの範囲であり、角の特異性や任意領域へ無条件に一般化しない。
limitations.en: Not a general mesh generator or implementation of curved elements, variable coefficients or mixed elements. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity. The additional2D Cartesian Noh edition updates both x/y fluxes and both momenta on a full square. The additional spherical Sedov blast measures grid and finite deposition-radius effects separately.

depth_scope.ja: 既存のHLL流束・Heunによる2D Double Mach反射を3格子で検証し、別実装の有限格子数値参照との差、境界流束収支、衝撃位置と未解像の壁近傍構造を示します。 追加の前向きステップ例は段差面を含む反射壁境界の実2D有限体積計算を検証します。 追加のGuderley例は、圧力ゼロの上流へ進む球対称収束衝撃波を原点到達前だけ計算し、半解析的な相似参照と比較します。 浅水系の地形源項と静水再構成を、全湿潤・露出床の静止湖とSWASHESの定常Bernoulli流で検査します。別の平坦床Ritter破堤は、真の乾燥状態・保存収支・固定水深の前縁を確認します。 追加の軽量1D SRHD対称衝突/SRMHD有限振幅円偏極波は、同じ完全7量の応力/誘導、MUSCL-minmod、因果的HLL±1、SSPRK33とZ回復を使用。一般Riemann・GR・極端速度の認証ではありません。
depth_scope.en: Three-grid 2D Double Mach verification using HLL and Heun compares a separately written finite-grid numerical reference, boundary-flux budgets, shock position and unresolved near-wall structure. The additional forward-step example verifies actual 2D finite-volume flow with reflecting walls including the step faces. The additional Guderley example evolves a zero-upstream-pressure spherical converging shock only before collapse and compares a semi-analytic similarity reference. Check shallow-water bed sources and hydrostatic reconstruction with wet/emerged lakes and a SWASHES steady Bernoulli flow. A separate flat-bed Ritter dam break tests genuinely dry states, conservation budgets and a fixed-depth front. Additional lightweight1D SRHD symmetric collision/SRMHD finite-amplitude CP wave use the shared full7-variable stress/induction,MUSCL-minmod,causalHLL±1,SSPRK33 and Z recovery; no generic Riemann,GR or extreme-speed claim.

summary.en: An approximate Riemann flux that restores the contact wave missing from HLL, improving Euler contact resolution. The released implementation is one-dimensional and perfect-gas, with Davis-type outer acoustic speeds.

assumptions: Left/right states are perfect-gas Euler variables (ρ,ρu,E), finite with ρ>0 and p>0, using a physical γ>1.
Outer speeds are S_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R) and S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R); the contact speed and two star states are computed algebraically.
HLLC supplies an interface flux. Reconstruction, time integration, CFL control and boundary states are provided by the caller.
The local HLLC branch accepts Euler only; availability of HLL for another model does not make this HLLC implementation applicable to it.
legacy_method_records.units: Use one consistent unit system on both sides. ρ is density, u, c and wave speeds are length/time, and p and E are energy/volume. Numerical fluxes have conserved-variable units times length/time. γ is dimensionless; released examples are nondimensional.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Physical boundary conditions do not belong to the interface-flux function. The caller constructs left/right states; the existing one-dimensional solver uses periodic, fixed-initial-endpoint or extrapolated-edge states.

limitations.ja: 接触波の復元は一般的な正値性・エントロピー安定性の保証ではない。このDavis型波速版を、強い希薄波・真空や一般EOS、MHD、相対論的流体に追加処理なしで用いない。静止接触の一致テストも、移動衝撃波や全問題での厳密性を意味しない。
limitations.en: Contact restoration is not a general positivity or entropy-stability guarantee. This Davis-speed version should not be extended without additional treatment to strong rarefactions, vacuum, general equations of state, MHD or relativistic flow. Exact agreement for a stationary contact does not imply an exact solution for moving shocks or arbitrary problems.

assumptions_ja: 左右状態は理想気体Eulerの(ρ,ρu,E)、有限かつρ>0、p>0で、物理的な比熱比γ>1を使う。
外側波速はS_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R)、S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R)。接触速度と左右star状態を代数的に計算する。
HLLCは界面流束であり、再構成、時間積分、CFLと境界状態は呼び出し側が与える。
本実装のHLLC分岐はEuler専用であり、HLLを使える他のモデルにも自動適用できるわけではない。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 左右で同じ単位系を使う。ρは密度、uとcと各波速は長さ/時間、pとEはエネルギー/体積。数値流束は保存量×長さ/時間の単位を持つ。γは無次元で、公開例も無次元。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 界面流束そのものには物理境界条件を指定しない。呼び出し元が左右状態を作る。既存1次元solverは周期・端点初期値固定・端値外挿を用いる。

ja: 正の理想気体状態から、HLLより鮮明な密度接触面を求めたい。

A flux component is needed in a Godunov-type solver that separately selects reconstruction, time integration and boundaries.

en: Guaranteed positivity is required near vacuum or extreme rarefactions.
A different HLLC formulation is needed for nonideal gases, shallow water or MHD.

depth_scope.ja: 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。 追加の2D Cartesian Noh版は正方形全域のx/y流束と2成分運動量を更新する軽量例です。 Sedov球対称爆発の追加例では、有限半径へのエネルギー投入と格子の影響を分けて測ります。 追加の前向きステップ例は段差面を含む反射壁境界の実2D有限体積計算を検証します。 追加のGuderley例は、圧力ゼロの上流へ進む球対称収束衝撃波を原点到達前だけ計算し、半解析的な相似参照と比較します。 非周期壁面の2D渦度・流れ関数法でRe100蓋駆動キャビティと製造流れを解きます。Ghia原著の有限格子数値表、壁剪断と格子収束を比較し、独立した圧力Poisson・勾配製造問題を区別します。 追加の周期2D KH/RT初期成長は、維持した滑らかな基底と独立線形IVPを使用。中央の保存面流束とHeunで渦度/浮力を実際に進め、圧力は消去します。 追加の全成分1D円偏波と実際の2D磁場ループ/Orszag–TangでHLLD・MC-MUSCL・Heunを使用。HLLD→HLLE代替と面の正値性スケーリングを数え、セルfloorや再試行は行いません。 追加ALEスカラーは面位置と質量を同じ2段Heunで更新し、同じ段重みの境界収支・GCLと独立時間参照を比較します。
depth_scope.en: An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity. The additional2D Cartesian Noh edition updates both x/y fluxes and both momenta on a full square. The additional spherical Sedov blast measures grid and finite deposition-radius effects separately. The additional forward-step example verifies actual 2D finite-volume flow with reflecting walls including the step faces. The additional Guderley example evolves a zero-upstream-pressure spherical converging shock only before collapse and compares a semi-analytic similarity reference. Solve a Re100 lid-driven cavity and manufactured flow with a nonperiodic wall-bounded2D vorticity/streamfunction method. Compare original finite-grid Ghia tables, wall shear and grid refinement, keeping a separate pressure-Poisson/gradient manufactured problem distinct. Additional periodic2D KH/RT initial growth uses maintained smooth bases and independent linear IVPs; actual centered conservative face fluxes and Heun evolve vorticity/buoyancy with pressure eliminated. Additional full-state1D CP wave and actual2D magnetic-loop/Orszag–Tang use HLLD,MC-MUSCL and Heun. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallback and face positivity scaling,with no cell floor or PDE retry. Additional ALE scalar advances face positions and mass with the same two-stage Heun weights,checking boundary budgets,GCL and an independent time reference.

depth_scope.ja: 背景Mach数.1/.01の滑らかな2D Euler等エントロピー渦で、両流束に無制限の中心primitive MUSCL再構築を用い、通常RoeとMiczek系の数値散逸行列前処理D=P⁻¹|PA|を比較します。SSPRK(3,3)で元の物理時間項と音響CFLを保ち、速度誤差・動圧規格化した圧力誤差・周期保存収支・標本Fourier診断を分けて評価します。擬似時間・二重時間積分の定常加速や、勾配制限・TVDの保証は扱いません。 追加の二重膨張波は1次元保存量MUSCL・共有Lax–Friedrichs流束・平均を保つ正値状態スケーリング・SSPRK(3,3)を接続した限定例です。許容CFLと波速条件、各前進Euler候補・SSP段の平均と面状態、保存収支を測り、一般のEuler・WENO・DG・MHDの正値性保証へ拡張しません。 追加のZalesak型例は与えた発散ゼロ速度による2次元スカラー回転輸送です。同一の周期格子・SSPRK(3,3)で一次風上とminmod MUSCLを比較し、各段の範囲・保存量と一回転後の形状誤差を調べます。FCT法や多次元Euler全般の有界性を認証しません。 追加の軽量1D SRHD対称衝突/SRMHD有限振幅円偏極波は、同じ完全7量の応力/誘導、MUSCL-minmod、因果的HLL±1、SSPRK33とZ回復を使用。一般Riemann・GR・極端速度の認証ではありません。
depth_scope.en: A fixed smooth 2D Euler isentropic vortex at background Mach numbers .1 and .01 compares ordinary Roe and Miczek-type dissipation-matrix preconditioning D=P⁻¹|PA|, with unlimited central primitive-variable MUSCL reconstruction for both. SSPRK(3,3) retains physical time and the acoustic CFL. Velocity error, dynamically normalized pressure error, periodic conservation and sampled Fourier diagnostics are evaluated separately. Pseudo-time or dual-time steady acceleration, slope limiting and TVD guarantees remain outside this example. The additional double rarefaction connects one-dimensional conservative MUSCL, shared Lax–Friedrichs fluxes, mean-preserving positive-state scaling and SSPRK(3,3). Check the admissible CFL/wave-speed conditions, means and faces at each forward-Euler candidate/SSP stage, and conservation budgets; this does not certify general Euler, WENO, DG or MHD positivity. The additional Zalesak-type example is two-dimensional scalar rotation in a prescribed divergence-free velocity. Compare donor-cell upwinding and minmod MUSCL with the same periodic grid and SSPRK(3,3), measuring stage bounds, conservation and full-turn shape errors. It does not certify FCT or general multidimensional Euler bounds. Additional lightweight1D SRHD symmetric collision/SRMHD finite-amplitude CP wave use the shared full7-variable stress/induction,MUSCL-minmod,causalHLL±1,SSPRK33 and Z recovery; no generic Riemann,GR or extreme-speed claim.

assumptions: The target is the initial-value problem y'=f(t,y), with sufficient smoothness of f and y for fourth-order convergence.
The adopted classical tableau has c=(0,1/2,1/2,1), a21=1/2, a32=1/2, a43=1 and b=(1,2,2,1)/6.
The caller selects the step. A semidiscrete PDE also imposes spatial spectral/CFL restrictions; linear modes require |R(hλ)|≤1.
legacy_method_records.units: h and t have the same time unit, and f_i has units y_i/time. State-component units belong to the problem; RK4 imposes no intrinsic physical unit. hλ is dimensionless.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to the ODE step itself. For a PDE, each stage's RHS evaluation must supply the appropriate boundary values or ghost states.

limitations.ja: 陽解法でA安定・L安定ではなく、硬い減衰では小さい刻みを要する。一般の非線形問題に正のSSP係数を持たず、正値性・TVD性・エネルギー保存・シンプレクティック性を4次精度から導くことはできない。このrk_stepは固定刻みの部品で、埋込み誤差推定や自動刻み調整を持たない。
limitations.en: Explicit RK4 is neither A-stable nor L-stable and may require small steps for stiff decay. It has no positive general nonlinear SSP coefficient; fourth-order accuracy implies neither positivity, TVD, energy conservation nor symplecticity. The released rk_step is a fixed-step component without an embedded error estimator or adaptive controller.

depth_scope.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。 Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。 FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。 セル平均からのWENO-JS／Z二乗重みの臨界点再構成と、実際の周期スカラー輸送を比較します。εの違い、解析セル平均と点値、空間誤差と時間刻みの影響を分けます。 追加は実際の2D C-grid線形回転浅水場をRK4で時間発展。同じ離散作用素の行列指数を参照にし、連続波の空間誤差と固定N時間細分化を区別します。
depth_scope.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions. Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode. FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853. Compare critical-point reconstruction from cell means using WENO-JS/Z power-two weights and actual periodic scalar transport. Separate epsilon choices, analytic cell means versus point values, and spatial error versus time-step effects. Additional actual2D C-grid linear rotating-SWE fields use RK4. A matrix exponential of the same semidiscrete operator is reference-only; separate continuous spatial and fixed-N temporal errors.

assumptions: The target is an ODE y'=f(t,y) represented by a real one-dimensional array, with a consistent Jacobian ∂f/∂y supplied by the caller.
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]], b=(1−γ,γ), c=(γ,1), and γ=1−1/√2. This stiffly accurate form returns the last stage.
With exact stage solves, R(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2. This γ gives A-stability and R→0 as |z|→∞ in the left half-plane.

Newton convergence is required at each stage. Distinguish fixed-step integrate from adaptive_sdirk2, which estimates error from (two half steps−one full step)/3 and accepts the two-half-step solution.
legacy_method_records.units: h has time units, f_i has y_i/time, and J_ij has y_i/(y_j×time). Nondimensionalization or component scaling is needed: the fixed Newton tolerance 2×10^-12 does not automatically adapt to arbitrary physical units. Adaptive atol sets state scales and rtol is dimensionless.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundaries do not apply to the ODE time step itself. For semidiscrete PDEs, incorporate boundary conditions and their time dependence consistently into the RHS and Jacobian.

limitations.ja: L安定性は正確な段階解を前提とする線形試験方程式の性質であり、大刻みの精度・非線形収束・正値性を保証しない。Newton失敗時は固定版が例外、適応版が試行棄却を行う。埋込み対ではなくステップ倍化で、rtol/atolは局所誤差尺度であり最終大域誤差の保証ではない。一般DAE、質量行列、イベント処理は未実装。
limitations.en: L-stability concerns the linear test equation with accurate stage solves; it guarantees neither large-step accuracy, nonlinear convergence nor positivity. A Newton failure raises in the fixed version and rejects a trial in the adaptive wrapper. Adaptivity uses step doubling, not an embedded pair; rtol/atol control a local error scale, not a guaranteed final global error. General DAEs, mass matrices and events are not implemented.

assumptions_ja: 対象は実数の1次元配列で表すODE y'=f(t,y)。整合するJacobian ∂f/∂yを呼び出し側が与える。
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]]、b=(1−γ,γ)、c=(γ,1)、γ=1−1/√2。最終段を次の解にするstiffly accurate版。
正確な段階解に対する安定関数はR(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2。このγではA安定かつ左半平面で|z|→∞のときR→0となる。
実装では各段階のNewton収束が必要。固定刻みintegrateと、(2半歩−1全歩)/3を使って2半歩の解を採用するadaptive_sdirk2を区別する。

summary.ja: 位置だけに依存する力を、半分のkick・drift・半分のkickで進める2次の可逆・シンプレクティック法。公開例は単位質量の調和/四次振動子で、エネルギー誤差と構造保存が同じでないことを確かめる。
summary.en: A second-order reversible symplectic method using half kick, drift and half kick for position-dependent forces. Released unit-mass harmonic/quartic oscillators illustrate why energy error and geometric structure preservation are different properties.

legacy_method_records.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Verlet (1967). Computer “Experiments” on Classical Fluids. I. Thermodynamical Properties of Lennard-Jones Molecules.
references.scope: Original position-Verlet recurrence in molecular dynamics. The atlas implements its kick–drift–kick phase-space form for a unit-mass oscillator, not the paper's Lennard-Jones simulation.

supports.ja: 原報の位置Verlet漸化式を本文で確認。本サイトは単位質量の振動子に対するkick–drift–kick形であり、原報のLennard–Jones流体を再現する実装ではない。
supports.en: The original position recurrence was inspected. The atlas adopts a kick–drift–kick oscillator form and does not reproduce the paper's Lennard-Jones experiment.

verification.locator: Section II, p. 99, equation (4); relevant integration passage read.

references.label: Hairer, Lubich & Wanner (2003). Geometric numerical integration illustrated by the Störmer–Verlet method.
references.scope: Research exposition of the method's reversibility, symplecticity and long-time behaviour; no claim that all constrained/manifold extensions are implemented.

supports.ja: 可逆性・シンプレクティック性と長時間挙動を整理する研究論文。抄録確認に限り、多様体・拘束系への拡張を本実装の機能とはしない。
supports.en: Research treatment of geometric and long-time properties. Only the abstract was checked; its manifold and constrained-system extensions are outside the local implementation.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and metadata; author-hosted PDF was inaccessible.

assumptions: The released example is an autonomous separable one-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q) with unit mass and V=q²/2 or q²/2+q⁴/4.
The force is −V'(q), depending only on position. The update is p_half=p−h V'(q)/2, q_new=q+h p_half, p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2.
Reversibility and symplecticity refer to the same fixed-step map. Dynamical time scales must still be resolved for accuracy and stability.
legacy_method_records.units: The released oscillator is nondimensional with m=1 and harmonic ω=1. A general-mass formulation would require drift h p/m and consistent position, momentum, force and time scales; that generalization is not an input feature of this released function.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to this oscillator phase-space map. It is a different problem from the original periodic Lennard-Jones fluid; particle periodicity, walls and constraints are not implemented here.

limitations.ja: 元のHamiltonianを各ステップで厳密保存するわけではない。シンプレクティックでも大刻みは不安定になり得て、ω=1の調和振動子では|h|<2が安定域の内部。速度依存力、摩擦・サーモスタット、拘束、一般の可変刻みや非分離Hamiltonianでは、同じ性質をそのまま保証できない。公開関数は一般分子動力学solverではない。
limitations.en: The original Hamiltonian is not exactly preserved at each step. A symplectic map can still be unstable at large steps; for the ω=1 harmonic oscillator, |h|<2 is the interior stability interval. Velocity-dependent forces, friction/thermostats, constraints, generic variable steps and nonseparable Hamiltonians require different treatment. This function is not a general molecular-dynamics solver.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 公開例は1自由度、単位質量の自律・分離Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q)。V=q²/2またはq²/2+q⁴/4。
力は−V'(q)で位置のみに依存する。p_half=p−h V'(q)/2、q_new=q+h p_half、p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2を用いる。
可逆性とシンプレクティック性の説明は固定刻みの同じ写像に対するもの。精度と安定性のため力学的時間尺度を解像する。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 公開振動子は質量m=1、調和角振動数ω=1に無次元化している。一般の質量に転用する場合はdriftをh p/mとし、q・p・力・時間の尺度を整合させる必要があるが、その一般化はこの公開関数の入力では提供しない。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: この振動子の位相空間写像に空間境界条件は該当しない。原報の周期Lennard–Jones流体とは別の問題であり、粒子の周期境界や壁・拘束はこの実装にない。

problem.ja: 位置依存ポテンシャルを持つHamilton系の軌道と長時間の幾何学的挙動。
problem.en: Trajectories and long-time geometric behaviour of Hamiltonian systems with a position-dependent potential.

variant.ja: hamiltonian._verletのkick–drift–kick（velocity-Verlet形）。公開の対象は単位質量の1次元調和・四次振動子で、Verlet原報の位置漸化式とは表現を区別する。
variant.en: Kick–drift–kick (velocity-Verlet form) in hamiltonian._verlet, restricted to unit-mass one-dimensional harmonic/quartic oscillators; distinguished from the original paper's position recurrence.

ja: 固定刻みで、分離Hamiltonianの可逆性・シンプレクティック性とエネルギー誤差を比較したい。
位置依存力の時間尺度を解像できる振動子の教材例が欲しい。
en: Compare fixed-step reversibility/symplecticity with energy error for a separable Hamiltonian.
An oscillator teaching example with resolved position-dependent-force time scales is useful.

ja: 速度依存力や摩擦、拘束を追加しても同じ構造保存が自動的に成り立つと期待する。

references.label: Hestenes, M. R. & Stiefel, E. (1952). Methods of Conjugate Gradients for Solving Linear Systems.
references.scope: Real SPD conjugate-gradient recurrence; not the heat time integrator used elsewhere in the chapter.

supports.ja: 実対称正定値系に対するCGの反復式と、丸め誤差がある場合の有限回終了の限界。
supports.en: CG recurrence for real SPD systems and the qualification of finite termination in floating-point arithmetic.

verification.locator: Sections 2–3, especially (3:1) and the discussion of rounding error, pp. 410–411.

assumptions: The operator must be real SPD and the right-hand side finite; the example discretizes constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square grid.
Inner products are Euclidean array products; the current implementation starts from zero and has no preconditioner.
poisson_comparison.solve stops on a recomputed true relative residual; linear.poisson_2d uses a recurrence residual with tolerance×max(1,initial residual).
legacy_method_records.units: CG has no intrinsic physical unit. The public Poisson coordinates have unit dimensionless length; dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]². Residual norms are unweighted array norms.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: CG itself supplies no physical boundary condition. The public 2D Poisson examples impose u=0 on every side of [0,1]² by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 非対称・不定・特異な系にそのまま適用しない。前処理、一般疎行列入力、純Neumannの零空間処理はこのCG例にはない。小さい残差は離散化誤差の保証ではなく、単一固有モードの速い終了を一般的性能と解釈しない。
limitations.en: Do not apply this variant directly to nonsymmetric, indefinite or singular systems. This CG example has no preconditioner, general sparse-matrix interface or pure-Neumann nullspace handling. A small residual does not certify discretization accuracy; rapid termination for one eigenmode is not a general performance result.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 作用素は実対称正定値で、右辺は有限。ここでは定係数の −Δu=f を一様正方格子で離散化する。
内積は配列成分のEuclidean内積。既存実装の初期値は零で、前処理は用いない。
poisson_comparison.solve は再計算した真の相対残差を停止に使う。linear.poisson_2d は反復残差と tolerance×max(1,初期残差) を使う。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: CG自体に固有の物理単位はない。公開Poisson例は長さ1の無次元座標で、次元を与えるなら [f]=[u]/[長さ]²。残差は格子体積で重み付けしない配列ノルム。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 代数解法としてのCGは境界を定めない。公開2次元Poisson例は [0,1]² の全辺で u=0 をゼロ埋め込みにより課す。

summary.ja: 細格子で平滑化し、粗格子で滑らかな誤差を補正する幾何学的多重格子法。公開実装は単位正方形の零Dirichlet Poisson問題に対する固定階層のV-cycle。
summary.en: Geometric multigrid combines fine-grid smoothing with coarse-grid correction of smooth error. The public implementation is a fixed-hierarchy V-cycle for zero-Dirichlet Poisson on the unit square.

legacy_method_records.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Brandt, A. (1977). Multi-Level Adaptive Solutions to Boundary-Value Problems.
references.scope: Multilevel interaction for boundary-value solvers; the atlas implements only a fixed nested-grid geometric V-cycle.

supports.ja: 粗密の格子間で情報を交換する多重格子法の一次研究。論文中の適応格子機能を実装済みとはしない。
supports.en: Primary multilevel boundary-value research; its adaptive capabilities are not claimed for the fixed-grid atlas example.

verification.locator: Abstract on printed p. 333 available in indexed primary-paper text; full PDF fetched but no readable body extracted. Author bibliography separately checked.

assumptions: Constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square interior grid with n=2^k−1 per axis.
Coarse operators are rediscretized five-point operators; restriction is full weighting, prolongation bilinear, with three red-black Gauss–Seidel pre/post sweeps by default.
The one-unknown coarsest problem is solved exactly. Entry points use either mixed absolute/relative residual stopping or the comparison's true relative residual.
legacy_method_records.units: The public problem uses dimensionless [0,1]² and h=1/(n+1). Dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]²; residual norms have no mesh weights.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: u=0 on all sides of [0,1]². Error corrections also have homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries, implemented by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 固定された正方形・定係数・入れ子格子の教育例。AMG、不規則格子、適応細分化、強い異方性や不連続係数用の特別な平滑化は実装しない。Brandt論文の全機能や任意問題での最適計算量を示すものではない。
limitations.en: An educational fixed-square, constant-coefficient nested-grid example. It does not implement AMG, irregular meshes, adaptive refinement or specialized smoothing for strong anisotropy/discontinuous coefficients. It does not establish all capabilities of Brandt's paper or optimal work for arbitrary problems.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f、正方形の一様内部格子、各軸 n=2^k−1 の入れ子格子を仮定する。
粗格子作用素は五点差分の再離散化。full weighting制限、双線形補間、red-black Gauss–Seidelの前後各3回平滑化を標準とする。
最粗格子1未知数は厳密に解く。停止判定は公開入口により絶対値を併用した残差または共通比較用の真の相対残差。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 公開問題は無次元の [0,1]²、h=1/(n+1)。次元を与える場合 [f]=[u]/[長さ]²、残差ノルムは格子重みなし。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: [0,1]² の全辺で u=0。誤差補正も零Dirichletで、ゼロ埋め込みにより境界値を入れる。

problem.ja: 定係数Poisson方程式の五点差分連立系。
problem.en: The five-point discrete system for constant-coefficient Poisson.

variant.ja: 再離散化した粗格子作用素とfull weighting/双線形転送を使う、red-black GSの幾何V-cycle。
variant.en: Geometric V-cycle with rediscretized coarse operators, full weighting, bilinear transfer and red-black GS.

ja: 規則的な入れ子正方格子のPoissonを解くとき。

en: Solving Poisson on a regular nested square hierarchy.
Studying smooth-error removal by coarse correction versus relaxation alone.

summary.ja: 非線形方程式 F(x)=0 を、Jacobianから求めたNewton方向と残差ノルムの十分減少による減衰で解く。公開例は密行列解法または前処理付きGMRESの内部解法を選べる。
summary.en: Solve F(x)=0 using a Jacobian-based Newton direction and damping that requires sufficient decrease of the residual norm. The example supports a dense or preconditioned GMRES inner solve.

legacy_method_records.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Armijo, L. (1966). Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives.
references.scope: Source for sufficient-decrease and halving-backtracking ideas; the atlas adapts the test to ||F||, not to the paper's steepest-descent problem.

supports.ja: 十分減少と刻みの半減という考え方の根拠。原論文の最小化の収束定理を、この非線形方程式実装の保証とはしない。
supports.en: Supports sufficient decrease and step halving; the minimization theorem is not a convergence certificate for this root solver.

verification.locator: Printed pp. 1–3; convergence theorem and Corollary 2, equation (2).

references.label: Dembo, R. S., Eisenstat, S. C. & Steihaug, T. (1982). Inexact Newton Methods.
references.scope: Newton equations and approximate inner linear solves; context for the GMRES path, not proof of the atlas's particular forcing rule.

supports.ja: Newton方程式を近似的に解く定式化。今回確認したのは抄録であり、実装固有の内部許容誤差の定理適合は未確認。
supports.en: Formulates approximate Newton solves; only the abstract was reviewed, not a theorem audit of the implemented inner tolerance.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata, as returned by web search; direct full text not reviewed.

assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
legacy_method_records.units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].

limitations.ja: 初期値、Jacobianの非特異性、残差の尺度に依存し、大域的収束は保証しない。特異な密行列解法や前処理構築は例外となることがあり、すべてが失敗理由の戻り値に変換されるわけではない。行列なしJv、信頼領域、継続法は備えない。
limitations.en: Convergence depends on the initial guess, Jacobian nonsingularity and residual scaling; global convergence is not guaranteed. Singular dense solves or preconditioner construction may raise exceptions rather than return a failure reason. No matrix-free Jv, trust region or continuation is provided.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: FとJacobianを利用者が与える。平方の微分可能な系と、解の近くで非特異なJacobianが基本となる。
長さ1から1/2ずつ減らし、||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂ を要求する。α<2⁻²⁰で失敗を返す。
GMRES経路でもJacobianは明示的に与える。CSRならILU(0)、それ以外ならJacobi前処理を使い、内部残差と外部絶対残差を区別する。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 固有の物理単位はなく、未知数・残差の尺度は呼び出し側が決める。単位・桁の違う残差成分を自動で無次元化しないため、ノルムと絶対許容誤差を使う前に尺度を揃える。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: Newton法自体に物理境界はない。境界はFとJacobianの組立て側が指定する。既存Bratu検査は [0,1] の両端零Dirichletを内部未知数の残差へ組み込む。

problem.ja: 微分可能な平方の非線形連立方程式 F(x)=0。
problem.en: A differentiable square nonlinear system F(x)=0.

variant.ja: 残差ノルムのArmijo型十分減少を用いる減衰Newton。内部線形解法はdenseまたはGMRESで、Jacobianは明示指定。
variant.en: Damped Newton with an Armijo-type residual-norm decrease test; explicit Jacobian and dense/GMRES inner solve.

ja: Jacobianを与えられ、根の候補に近い初期値があるとき。
非線形問題で線形解法の誤差と減衰の作用を分けて確認するとき。
en: A Jacobian and an initial guess near a candidate root are available.
Examining the separate effects of inner linear accuracy and damping.

ja: Jacobianが特異になる点や、解が複数ある問題を初期値依存なしに解きたい場合。
制約付き最適化やJacobianなしの巨大問題をこのまま解く場合。
en: Requiring initial-guess-independent results near singular Jacobians or multiple roots.
Direct use for constrained optimization or very large Jacobian-free problems.

reason.en: Boundaries belong to the supplied residual/Jacobian.

reason.ja: 失敗理由と例外が返る経路を区別した。

depth_scope.ja: 背景Mach数.1/.01の滑らかな2D Euler等エントロピー渦で、両流束に無制限の中心primitive MUSCL再構築を用い、通常RoeとMiczek系の数値散逸行列前処理D=P⁻¹|PA|を比較します。SSPRK(3,3)で元の物理時間項と音響CFLを保ち、速度誤差・動圧規格化した圧力誤差・周期保存収支・標本Fourier診断を分けて評価します。擬似時間・二重時間積分の定常加速や、勾配制限・TVDの保証は扱いません。
depth_scope.en: A fixed smooth 2D Euler isentropic vortex at background Mach numbers .1 and .01 compares ordinary Roe and Miczek-type dissipation-matrix preconditioning D=P⁻¹|PA|, with unlimited central primitive-variable MUSCL reconstruction for both. Pseudo-time or dual-time steady acceleration, slope limiting and TVD guarantees remain outside this example.

depth_scope.ja: Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較: 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。 CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。 Orszag–Tang：条件を揃えたCT・GLMと独立参照の収束: 同じOT初期セル平均と同じdt列でCT/GLMを計算し、別に実行したAthena++の格子・時間感度を分離した参照と比較します。 CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照: 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。 追加の実際の2D磁場ループと衝撃波形成後Orszag–Tangで、edge EMFとface磁場のCT更新を使用。独立Athenaの有限格子参照と発散・エネルギーを別々に確認します。
depth_scope.en: Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++: Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++. CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence. Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references: Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated. Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control: Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem. Additional actual2D magnetic-loop and postshock Orszag–Tang use edge EMFs and face-field CT updates. Separately check divergence/energy against finite-grid independent Athena references.

references.label: Eastwood, J. W. & Hockney, R. W. (1974). Shaping the force law in two-dimensional particle-mesh models.
references.scope: Primary PM charge-sharing/CIC and Fourier-force-shaping research in 2D; context for assignment and mesh-force errors, not a derivation of this 3D gravity implementation.

supports.ja: PMのCICを含む割当てと格子の力の誤差に直接関係する一次研究。2次元の論文であり、本実装の3次元Green関数を検証する文献とはしない。
supports.en: Directly supports PM assignment/CIC and mesh-force error context; this 2D paper is not a validation of the implemented 3D Green function.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and metadata returned by web search; full text not reviewed.

assumptions: A cubic periodic box, positive finite particle masses, finite positions, cubic n³ mesh with n≥4 and L>0; coordinates wrap modulo L in every axis.
CIC deposits to eight vertices with product-linear weights divided by cell volume; interpolation uses the same weights. No CIC-window deconvolution is applied.
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−meanρ), with φ̂(0)=0. Nonzero modes use −4πG/k² and acceleration is −∇φ. On even meshes, each derivative zeroes its own-axis Nyquist mode to retain a real odd operator.
legacy_method_records.units: pm_acceleration is a dimensionless G=1 example. L and positions share a length unit; density, potential and acceleration scale as M/L³, GM/L and GM/L². Only the lower-level periodic_poisson accepts a positive gravity parameter.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Periodic in all directions with box length L. Mean removal enforces periodic-Poisson compatibility, while zeroing k=0 fixes the additive potential gauge. This is not the isolated-force problem.

limitations.ja: 格子以下の近接力を直接補正しないPMのみの静的例。CIC平滑化、格子異方性・aliasing・有限解像度があり、連続Fourier Green関数を有限差分Laplacianの離散逆作用素と混同しない。P3M・TreePM分割・Ewald・PME/SPME・宇宙膨張・時間積分は含まない。
limitations.en: A static PM-only example without direct short-range correction. CIC smoothing, grid anisotropy, aliasing and finite resolution remain; the continuum Fourier Green function is not the inverse symbol of a finite-difference Laplacian. No P3M, TreePM split, Ewald, PME/SPME, expansion or time integration is included.

assumptions: Positions are finite (N,3), masses positive and finite, and N≥1; ε=softening>0, theta≥0 and order is 0 or 2.
A node is accepted when s/d<theta, with s=2×half and d measured to its center of mass. Target-containing cells are always opened; leaves exclude self terms.
The acceleration kernel is −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2). order=2 adds the full Taylor term from S=Σmδδᵀ, retaining trace(S) for the softened kernel.
legacy_method_records.units: Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.

limitations.ja: 静的な力の教育例で、時間積分・宇宙膨張・周期境界・FMMを含まない。thetaは厳密な誤差上限ではなく、order=2がすべての配置で常に改善する保証もない。対象ごとの近似なので厳密な作用反作用・全運動量保存は保証せず、相互作用回数は実時間や全分布でのO(N log N)の実測ではない。
limitations.en: A static-force educational example without time integration, expansion, periodic images or FMM. theta is not a rigorous error bound, and order=2 need not improve every configuration. Targetwise approximation does not guarantee exact action–reaction/total-momentum conservation. Interaction counts are not timings or empirical complexity guarantees for every distribution.

summary.en: Represent reference-interval functions in Legendre modes. The implementation tabulates P₀…Pₚ and derivatives, optionally normalizes them, and computes unweighted L2 projection and affine element matrices by Gauss quadrature.

supports.ja: 重み1のLegendre展開・規格化と節点値との変換を参照する。Legendre多項式の歴史的起源の主張には用いない。
