verification.locator: Author preprint: Section 2, equations (1)–(18), and Section 3.1, equations (19)–(23); journal DOI/year/pages checked against publisher metadata.

assumptions: The reference interval is [−1,1] with weight one: ∫PⱼPₖdξ=2δⱼₖ/(2k+1); orthonormal=True multiplies by √((2k+1)/2).
Degree is a nonnegative integer. project_legendre approximates projection integrals by Gauss quadrature, leaving quadrature error for general functions.
Exact element-matrix quadrature means p+1 Gauss points for polynomial products with constant coefficients and an affine map.
legacy_method_records.units: ξ and basis values are dimensionless. On an affine interval of length L, J=L/2 scales mass by J and gradient stiffness by 1/J. Expansion coefficients share the represented function's units.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Basis evaluation/projection imposes no physical boundary condition. Endpoint values/fluxes and interelement coupling belong to the consuming discretization; the constant stiffness nullspace is not removed automatically.

limitations.ja: 中程度の次数向けの教育用表作成で、高次数での安定性・最適化を保証しない。不連続関数では単一多項式の収束と求積が制約される。Chebyshev基底の重みをLegendreの重み1と混同せず、GLL求積による最高モードの質量を厳密質量と同一視しない。
limitations.en: Educational tabulation for modest degrees, without high-degree stability/performance guarantees. Discontinuities limit single-polynomial approximation and quadrature. Do not confuse Chebyshev weights with the unit Legendre weight, or GLL quadrature's highest-mode mass with exact mass.

assumptions: Interval nodes must be distinct finite real values at modest degree; cardinal polynomials are evaluated through a Legendre Vandermonde solve.
For p≥1, GLL nodes are ±1 and roots of Pₚ′. A p+1-point GLL rule is exact through degree 2p−1, not generally for degree-2p mass products.
Triangle functions are only P1/P2 on (0,0),(1,0),(0,1). Quadrilaterals use Qₚ tensor products with (p+1)² degrees of freedom.

limitations.ja: 高次数のVandermonde解法は条件数の制約を受け、安定なbarycentric表作成や汎用高次要素の代替ではない。等間隔節点の高次補間にはRunge現象がある。GLL集中質量と厳密質量のrank-1差は重み1・アフィン区間での結果で、三角形全般へ適用しない。
limitations.en: High-degree Vandermonde solves face conditioning limits and are not a replacement for stable barycentric tabulation or a general high-order element library. High-degree equispaced interpolation can exhibit Runge behavior. The rank-one exact/lumped GLL mass difference concerns the unweighted affine interval, not arbitrary triangles.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional perfect-gas Euler on a uniform Cartesian grid, with finite positive density and pressure at each stage.
q contains point values, not cell averages. A global a=max|u±c| splits f±=(f±a q)/2; oppositely biased five-point stencils reconstruct the two fluxes.
Weights use d=(0.1,0.6,0.3), Jiang–Shu β_k, τ_5=|β_0−β_2| and α_k=d_k[1+(τ_5/(ε+β_k))²], with default ε=10^-6.
Both split fluxes use the same face-frozen Roe characteristic basis by default; component reconstruction is optional. Time integration is SSPRK(3,3), with 0<CFL≤0.5.
legacy_method_records.units: Released Euler examples are nondimensional. With dimensional data, β and τ scale as the squared projected flux, so the effect of a fixed ε=10^-6 changes with scaling. Nondimensionalize states/fluxes or choose a scale-consistent ε. Use compatible units for Δt, Δx and wave speed.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: reconstruction._pad uses periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states or edge extrapolation. Uniform high-order boundary accuracy and nonreflection are not guaranteed.

limitations.ja: 5次は滑らかな領域での空間精度であり、時間は3次。不連続近傍で同じ次数は期待できず、ε・尺度・基底の影響を受ける。段階で非正値になると時間刻みを半減して再試行するが、これは正値性の定理ではない。WENO分岐はHLLCを使わず、有限体積PPM/MUSCL用の正値再構成スケーリングも使わない。
limitations.en: Fifth order refers to smooth-region spatial accuracy; time accuracy is third order. The same order is not expected near discontinuities, and ε, scaling and basis matter. Invalid stages trigger step halving and retries, which do not constitute a positivity theorem. The WENO branch uses neither HLLC nor the positive-reconstruction scaling used by the finite-volume PPM/MUSCL branch.

assumptions: The initial validation specification is noncoincident point charges in a cubic, triply periodic Coulomb cell with zero net charge and no uniform neutralizing background.

legacy_method_records.units: Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.

assumptions: One electron in the Coulomb potential -Z/r of an isolated, infinite-mass point nucleus; nonrelativistic and field-free.
Separate angular momentum l and solve for the reduced radial orbital u(r), normalized by integral |u|^2 dr=1.
Released inputs use Z=1,2 and (n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2); these cases do not cover arbitrary many-electron states.
A uniform interior radial grid and a real symmetric tridiagonal second-order kinetic operator are used.
legacy_method_records.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2).
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0. Released hydrogenic refinement inputs use r_max=60 bohr; a separate Z=1 1s study uses r_max=4,8,16,32 bohr. Origin and infinity are approximated by regularity and finite-box Dirichlet conditions.

limitations.en: Not a general many-electron, time-dependent, molecular, periodic or relativistic solver; nuclear motion and spin–orbit effects are absent. periodic_scope.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
periodic_scope.en: Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.

force_scope.ja: 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
force_scope.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

summary.ja: 単一Slater行列式により交換を含む平均場を求める。公開実装は球対称He 1s²の閉殻解に限り、1個の空間軌道で成立する局所交換への簡約を用いる。
summary.en: Find an exchange-containing mean field in a single Slater determinant. The released implementation is restricted to spherical closed-shell helium 1s² and uses the local reduction valid for one occupied spatial orbital.

assumptions: Atomic branch: Nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2, an infinite-mass point nucleus and two opposite-spin electrons occupying the same spherical 1s spatial orbital.
Atomic branch: Normalize integral |u|^2 dr=1 and define p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n, so integral p dr=2.
Atomic branch: For this occupied orbital only, the Fock equation reduces to the effective field -2/r+v_H/2 and E_x=-E_H/2; no general nonlocal Fock operator is implemented.
Atomic branch: Single-determinant exchange is included; electron correlation is omitted.
Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.
legacy_method_records.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.

limitations.ja: この局所交換の簡約を多軌道・開殻・分子・周期系へそのまま拡張できない。原子版ではUHF/ROHF・分子積分・軌道安定性解析を扱わない。保存PySCF RHF参照は独立な有限Gaussian基底計算であり、相関を含むHeの厳密エネルギーではない。格子・箱幅・SCF収束と物理モデル誤差を区別する。 H₂では別の分子積分実装を用いる。分子DFT・一般多中心分子・開殻・軌道安定性解析は未実装。
limitations.en: The local exchange reduction cannot be transferred unchanged to multi-orbital, open-shell, molecular or periodic systems. The atomic edition does not implement UHF/ROHF, molecular integrals or orbital-stability analysis. Saved PySCF RHF references are independent finite-Gaussian-basis calculations, not exact correlated helium energies. Separate grid, domain and SCF convergence from physical model error. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Ground-state nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2 and one doubly occupied spherical 1s Kohn–Sham orbital.
Atomic/molecular examples: p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n and integral p dr=2, with n the total positive electron-number density of both spins.
Atomic/molecular examples: The adopted approximation is E_x[n]=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r, v_x=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), and E_c=v_c=0.
Atomic/molecular examples: The effective field is -2/r+v_H+v_x; second-order radial differences and simple density mixing solve this restricted model.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
legacy_method_records.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：厳密汎関数の理論とDirac交換のみという近似を区別する。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybrid、スピン分極、分子、周期バンド計算、励起は未実装。格子収束や独立な同一モデルとの一致は汎関数の物理精度を保証しない。KS固有値を一般の励起エネルギーと同一視しない。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Separate exact-functional theory from the adopted Dirac exchange-only approximation. LDA correlation, GGA, meta-GGA, hybrids, spin polarization, molecules, periodic bands and excitations are not implemented. Grid convergence or agreement with an independent implementation of the same model does not establish functional accuracy. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

caution.ja: 正確な汎関数の理論と、近似汎関数による実計算を分けます。KS固有値を一般に励起エネルギーと同一視せず、基底状態DFTだけで励起状態まで保証しません。
caution.en: Distinguish exact-functional theory from calculations with approximate functionals. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies; ground-state DFT alone does not guarantee excited-state accuracy.

example_scope.ja: 球対称Heのスピン非偏極・交換のみDirac LDA。相関・GGA・hybrid・分子・周期系・励起は未実装。

同じ交換のみモデルで動径差分と独立PySCF RKS/Libxc参照を比較する。
en: Keep potentials and total energies consistent with an explicitly specified exchange functional.
Compare radial differences against independent PySCF RKS/Libxc references for the same exchange-only model.

en: Treating this helium example as validated GGA/hybrid, molecular, periodic or excited-state software.
Interpreting agreement within the same approximation as agreement with experiment or a correlated exact solution.

reason.en: Checked closed-shell helium occupations and exchange-only lda_x.

periodic_scope.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
periodic_scope.en: Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.

force_scope.ja: 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
force_scope.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

summary.ja: 密度と有効場が整合する固定点を求める。孤立Heでは線形密度混合、H₂では独自RHF反復、周期HeではPySCFのSCFを使い、各例で残差・反復履歴・終了理由を確認する。
summary.en: Find a fixed point consistent with its effective field. Isolated He uses linear density mixing, H₂ an original RHF iteration, and periodic He PySCF SCF; each example checks residuals, iteration histories and termination.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The fixed-point map is the released spherical He 1s² HF or exchange-only LDA radial model, not a general molecular or periodic SCF implementation.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Mix input and output radial number densities: p_next=(1-alpha)p_in+alpha p_out, 0<alpha<=1; released baseline alpha=0.35 and an alternative start uses 0.7.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Each eigenproblem normalizes u and sets p_out=2|u|^2, so the electron-number normalization is imposed within the iteration.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Convergence requires input/output density L1<1e-9 electrons, |energy change|<1e-10 hartree, and the output-density-rebuilt orbital residual<1e-7 hartree; maximum 300 iterations.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The atlas iteration implements no DIIS, Anderson or Newton acceleration. An independent PySCF reference may use its own solver algorithms.

Atomic/molecular examples: Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
legacy_method_records.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Mixing alpha and iteration number are dimensionless. Radial p is in bohr^(-1), integral |p_out-p_in| dr is electron number, and energy changes/normalized orbital residuals are in hartree. Published tolerances belong to this normalization and model. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: SCF mixing itself imposes no spatial boundary condition. The supplied helium fixed-point map uses reduced-orbital u(0)=u(r_max)=0 and an isolated finite-origin, N/r Hartree field; see the HF/KS/Hartree records. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

next_deliverable.ja: 既存の小規模例の固定入力・保存済み参照・配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表ケースを再実行する。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMDは、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：エネルギー変化だけで収束を宣言しない。電子数が2に保たれることは実装の整合性検査であり、独立な物理検証ではない。異なる初期値での一致も解の一意性・軌道安定性・大域的最低エネルギーを証明しない。Pulay文献は未採用の加速法の文脈用で、単純密度混合の実装出典ではない。 H₂では別の分子積分実装を用いる。分子DFT・一般多中心分子・開殻・軌道安定性解析は未実装。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Energy change alone is insufficient. Electron number staying at two is an imposed consistency check, not independent physical validation. Agreement from alternative starts does not prove uniqueness, orbital stability or a global energy minimum. The Pulay reference is context for an unimplemented acceleration method, not the source of the simple density-mixing implementation. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

metadata_review.level: method-specific primary-source and released-code inspection; saved 2026-11-21 results read; no new numerical run

molecular_scope_note.ja: 新しいH₂の閉殻RHF例：自作s型Gaussian積分、独立PySCF比較、SCF残差・基底拡大を確認。有限のs型部分空間に限定し、一般分子・分子DFT・周期系・正しい解離極限は検証しません。
molecular_scope_note.en: New H₂ closed-shell RHF example: original s-Gaussian integrals, independent PySCF comparisons, SCF residuals and basis refinement. Limited to finite s-type subspaces; does not validate general molecules, molecular DFT, periodic systems or correct dissociation.

assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：固定点写像は公開する球対称He 1s²のHFまたは交換のみLDA動径モデルであり、汎用の分子・周期系SCF実装ではない。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：入力・出力の動径電子数密度をp_next=(1−α)p_in+αp_out（0<α≤1）で混合。公開基本値α=0.35、別の初期値では0.7も用いる。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：各固有値問題でuを規格化しp_out=2|u|²とするため、電子数の規格化は反復内で課している。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：密度の入出力L1差<10⁻⁹電子数、|エネルギー変化|<10⁻¹⁰hartree、出力密度で再構成した軌道残差<10⁻⁷hartreeをすべて要求。最大300反復。
原子・分子の実行例：従来の原子例：アトラス側の反復にDIIS・Anderson・Newton加速は未採用。独立PySCF参照は独自のソルバーを使いうる。
原子・分子の実行例：別の分子例：H₂の有限s型Gaussian基底RHF。自作の1・2電子積分と行列SCFを用い、公差・収束はH₂入力と検証結果で確認する。
固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：混合率αと反復回数は無次元。pはbohr⁻¹、∫|p_out−p_in|drは電子数、エネルギー変化と規格化した軌道残差はhartree。公開公差はこの規格化とモデルに対する値。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：SCF混合そのものに空間境界条件はない。与えたHe固定点写像が縮約軌道u(0)=u(r_max)=0と、原点で有限・遠方N/rの孤立Hartree場を規定する。HF・KS・Hartree項目を参照。 別のH₂側は孤立分子の全空間Gaussian解析積分で、有限の動径箱は設けない。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。

caution.ja: 小さいエネルギー変化だけで収束を宣言しません。収束した解が最低エネルギーの安定な電子状態である保証も別に検査します。
caution.en: A small energy change alone is insufficient. Convergence also does not establish the lowest-energy stable electronic solution.

example_scope.ja: Heの線形密度混合、密度・エネルギー・軌道残差、初期値・混合率の比較と未収束を検証。DIISは含みません。 別配布版にH₂の有限s型Gaussian基底RHFの例を追加。

problem.ja: 指定した電子密度依存ハミルトニアンと密度の自己整合固定点を求め、未収束を識別する。 別実装のH₂分子RHFも学ぶ。

variant.ja: 単純線形密度混合。密度L1差・エネルギー変化・出力密度で再構成した軌道残差のAND条件、履歴保存、反復上限による明示的未収束。 H₂側の分子積分・行列SCFは別配布版。

ja: 小さなHeモデルで混合率・初期値・停止基準を比較する。

en: Compare mixing rates, starts and stopping criteria in a small helium model.
Distinguish process completion from convergence, including an intentional one-iteration failure.

ja: 金属・難収束系や汎用分子SCFで、この混合率と公差が常に適切とみなす。
反復が停止した事実だけで安定性・最低エネルギー・物理精度を保証する。
en: Assuming the same mixing and tolerances are generally suitable for metals, difficult systems or molecular SCF.
Using iteration termination alone to establish stability, minimum energy or physical accuracy.

assumptions: A nonnegative spherically symmetric electron-number density n(r), with p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) and integral p dr=N; released helium uses N=2.
For an isolated system, v_H(r)=integral_0^R p(s)/max(r,s) ds and E_H=(1/2) integral p(r)v_H(r) dr.
The code uses uniform-grid cumulative quadrature with p=0 at the two endpoints and zero density outside the finite box; the same-radius quadrature sample is counted once.

v_H is positive electron repulsion and satisfies Laplacian(v_H)=-4 pi n in atomic units. Signed electronic charge density is -n; v_H is electron potential energy, not the electrostatic potential generated by that negative charge.
legacy_method_records.units: Atomic units: r in bohr, n in bohr^(-3), p in bohr^(-1), N an electron number, v_H and E_H in hartree. The positive-number-density convention fixes the Poisson sign.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Isolated spherical Coulomb boundary: v_H is finite at the origin and equals N/r outside the truncated density support. It is not a zero-Dirichlet condition at r_max. Endpoint p=0 is inherited from the reduced orbital; no periodic neutrality/background convention is implemented.

limitations.ja: 球対称・孤立・有限箱で切断した密度用の積分評価。非球対称、一般の境界形状、周期系、Ewaldや背景電荷、点電荷の特異自己エネルギーは扱わない。同半径標本の重複回避は求積の会計であり、DFTの物理的自己相互作用を除去する操作ではない。He HFでの自己相互作用相殺は別の交換簡約に由来する。
limitations.en: An integral evaluator for spherical isolated densities truncated in a finite box. It does not treat nonspherical/general boundaries, periodicity, Ewald/background charges or singular point-charge self-energies. Avoiding a double-counted same-radius sample is quadrature bookkeeping, not removal of DFT self-interaction; the helium-HF cancellation comes from the separate exchange reduction.

assumptions_ja: 非負・球対称の電子数密度n(r)を仮定。p(r)=4πr²n(r)、∫p dr=Nと定義し、公開He例はN=2。
孤立系のv_H(r)=∫₀ᴿp(s)/max(r,s)dsとE_H=(1/2)∫p(r)v_H(r)drを評価する。
一様格子の累積求積を用い、両端p=0、有限箱外の密度は0とする。同じ半径の求積標本を1回だけ数える。
v_Hは正の電子間反発で、原子単位系で∇²v_H=−4πn。符号付き電子電荷密度は−nであり、v_Hは負電荷が作る静電ポテンシャルそのものではなく電子のポテンシャルエネルギー。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 原子単位系。rはbohr、nはbohr⁻³、pはbohr⁻¹、Nは電子数、v_HとE_Hはhartree。正の電子数密度という規約とPoisson式の符号を組にする。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・球対称Coulomb境界。v_Hは原点で有限、切断した密度の外側ではN/r。r_maxで0とするDirichlet条件ではない。端点p=0は縮約軌道から与え、周期系の中性化・背景電荷の規約は実装していない。

caution.ja: Poisson解の残差、積分した電子数、遠方の挙動、二重計数の1/2を別々に確かめます。周期セルの帯電系を孤立系のエネルギーとして解釈しません。
caution.en: Check the Poisson residual, integrated electron number, far-field behavior and the one-half double-counting factor separately. A charged periodic cell does not directly give an isolated-system energy.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Use the total spin-unpolarized positive number density n=n_up+n_down, with n_up=n_down=n/2; in the radial example n=p/(4 pi r^2).
Atomic/molecular examples: The implemented exchange is E_x=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r and v_x=delta E_x/delta n=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), hence E_x=(3/4) integral p v_x dr.
Atomic/molecular examples: Set E_c=v_c=0 explicitly. This is not LDA plus a correlation parameterization and not Slater X-alpha with an unspecified coefficient.
Atomic/molecular examples: The public execution uses spherical closed-shell He 1s² and independently compares the same exchange-only choice against PySCF with xc='LDA_X,'.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
legacy_method_records.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units: total number density n in bohr^(-3), radial p in bohr^(-1), local v_x in hartree, and integrated E_x in hartree. The energy functional and its derivative use the same density and spin convention. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: The local exchange functional itself has no spatial boundary condition. The density/orbital problem supplies the isolated helium box and normalization. Gradient, nonlocal-exchange or periodic-functional boundaries are outside this implementation. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：相関、スピン分極、密度勾配、運動エネルギー密度、非局所交換を含まない。PBE・SCAN・hybridを実装・検証したという意味ではない。同一汎関数の独立実装との一致や格子収束は、交換相関モデルの精度・自己相互作用誤差・実験への一致を保証しない。Dirac原論文のThomas原子近似と本例のKS軌道解法を区別する。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: No correlation, spin polarization, density gradients, kinetic-energy-density ingredients or nonlocal exchange. PBE, SCAN and hybrid methods are not implemented or validated here. Agreement with an independent implementation of the same functional or grid convergence does not establish model accuracy, eliminate self-interaction error or guarantee experimental agreement. Distinguish Dirac's historical Thomas-atom approximation from this KS orbital solver. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：両スピンを合計した正の電子数密度n=n_up+n_downを用い、n_up=n_down=n/2のスピン非偏極を仮定。動径例ではn=p/(4πr²)。
原子・分子の実行例：実装はE_x=−(3/4)(3/π)¹ᐟ³∫n⁴ᐟ³d³r、v_x=δE_x/δn=−(3n/π)¹ᐟ³で、E_x=(3/4)∫p v_x dr。
原子・分子の実行例：E_c=v_c=0を明示する。相関のパラメータ化を追加したLDAでも、係数不明のSlater Xαでもない。
原子・分子の実行例：公開実行は球対称・閉殻He 1s²。独立参照もxc='LDA_X,'と指定し、同じ交換のみ近似を比較する。
固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：原子単位系。全電子数密度nはbohr⁻³、動径密度pはbohr⁻¹、局所v_xと積分したE_xはhartree。エネルギー汎関数とその微分で密度・スピンの規約をそろえる。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：局所交換汎関数自体には空間境界条件はない。密度・軌道の問題が孤立Heの箱と規格化を与える。勾配項・非局所交換・周期系の境界処理は実装対象外。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。

caution.en: Basis, grid and SCF convergence do not remove functional error. Assess self-interaction, charge transfer, strong correlation and dispersion for the chosen system and approximation.

summary.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。 AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差: 49・225・961未知数のSPD行列で、条件数と異方性を別々に変えます。解析スペクトル、独立疎行列直接解、DST対角化を比較し、同じ残差でも解誤差が条件数に依存することを確かめます。
summary.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error.

limitations.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける: 3格子の固定スカラー問題だけの確認です。係数の大きな不連続、強い異方性、弾性系、任意の非構造格子、最適計算量・格子独立収束を保証しません。小さい残差だけを小さい解誤差の証明としません。 AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差: 固定した小規模な一定係数系列のみです。任意の係数ジャンプ、非構造格子、不定値系、最適計算量・一様収束を保証しません。異方性が常にκ₂を増やす、あるいは単調に収束を悪化させるとは主張しません。
limitations.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error: Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Only a small constant-coefficient family is checked. Arbitrary coefficient jumps, unstructured grids, indefinite systems, optimal complexity and uniform convergence are outside scope. No claim that anisotropy necessarily increases κ₂ or monotonically worsens convergence.

AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error.

limitations.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗: 完全なLAPACK置換、複素行列、横長行列、任意の極端なスケール、最適な相対特異値精度を保証しません。10⁻¹²未満の特異値は入力した数値階数の規約で打ち切るため、数学的な厳密階数と区別します。Demmel–Veselićの精度定理の全条件を実証したとは主張しません。 QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数: LAPACKと教材の射影コアには共通の数値基盤が含まれます。mpmath SVDは別実装の二重対角化とQR反復、mpmath最小二乗は同じHouseholder群の別高精度実装です。どの高条件数行列にも微小特異値の相対高精度を保証するものではありません。
limitations.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results. QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank: Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.

limitations.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束: 非再始動・小行列・分離した極端固有対の教材です。内部固有値、クラスタ、巨大な疎行列、強い非正規性、shift-invertやimplicitly restarted Arnoldiは対象外です。小さな固有対残差だけで非正規行列の固有値誤差の厳密上界とはしません。 Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度: NumPyの射影コアとSciPyの密参照はLAPACK基盤を共有し得るため、全面的に独立なバックエンドとはしません。解析固有値と独立構成対照を併用します。再始動、内部固有値、大規模疎行列、普遍的な単調収束は対象外です。
limitations.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals: Unrestarted small-matrix educational examples with separated extreme eigenpairs. Interior/clustered eigenvalues, very large sparse matrices, strong nonnormality, shift-invert and implicitly restarted Arnoldi are outside scope. A small eigenpair residual alone is not treated as a rigorous eigenvalue-error bound for nonnormal matrices. Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity: NumPy projected solves and SciPy dense references may share LAPACK infrastructure and are not claimed fully independent backends. Analytic eigenvalues and constructed controls provide additional checks. Restarting, interior eigenvalues, large sparse systems and universal monotonic convergence are outside scope.

summary.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
summary.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

limitations.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ: Simpsonの局所推定は任意の関数に対する厳密な誤差上界ではありません。高周波の見落とし、特異点、丸め誤差の停滞を一般に解決する実装ではなく、Gauss–KronrodやQUADPACK全体の再実装でもありません。 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点: Simpsonの推定値は厳密誤差上界ではありません。盲点の検出に合格しても積分精度への合格ではありません。平方根の直接積分は深さ予算で未収束と表示し得ます。任意の振動・特異性の完全な探索や認証付き求積は主張しません。
limitations.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: The Simpson estimate is not a certified error bound. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget. Exhaustive oscillatory/singular exploration and certified quadrature are not claimed.

limitations.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS: 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。 MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。 定数observableのESS=NというArviZ raw規約を混合の証拠にしません。全同値はnull＋status、鎖ごとに異なる定数のRhatはnull＋infinite-separationとして、ライブラリの巨大finite/infを残し通常有限値の一致点から除外します。bulk ESSは原スケール平均のMCSEへ流用しません。
limitations.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate. Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. ArviZ raw constant-ESS=N is not evidence of mixing. Globally identical values yield null/status; differing per-chain constants yield null/infinite-separation Rhat while retaining raw huge-finite/infinite library values outside ordinary finite comparisons. Bulk ESS is not a raw-mean MCSE estimator.

metadata_review.level: scoped Gaussian and multimodal examples; rank/folded diagnostics independently compared with a pinned library, without inferring general convergence

summary.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation: Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

limitations.ja: Langevin温度制御：正準分布・刻み偏り・時間相関: 調和ポテンシャル・固定seedの分布検証です。位置分散が正確でも運動量には有限刻み偏りがあります。他のサーモスタット、一般分子系、長時間の第一原理MDへ検証を移しません。 CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。 非調和CSVRとLangevin：Boltzmann求積との分布比較: 特定の分離可能な四次2自由度・固定seedだけの小さな例です。Hを調和系のGamma分布と扱いません。全系相関には独立な厳密動力学参照がなく、相関一致や統計誤差に隠れる時間次数を合格主張しません。成熟分子系・輸送係数・量子・第一原理MDの検証ではありません。
limitations.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation: Distribution checks use a harmonic potential and fixed seeds. Exact position variance does not remove finite-step momentum bias. Evidence does not transfer to other thermostats, general molecules or long ab initio MD. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: A small example for one separable two-mode quartic potential and fixed seeds. H is not treated as harmonic Gamma. No independent exact full-system dynamical reference is claimed, and neither matching correlations nor time order hidden by sampling noise is an acceptance claim. Molecular transport, quantum and ab initio MD are outside scope.

Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. summary.ja: 右辺を2つの部分流に分け、全刻みずつ順に合成する1次の時間積分法。Strangとの公式・交換子・局所と大域の誤差・非可換な小例を比較する。 同じ32格子のSchnakenberg問題を比較する専用コード・固定入力・追試記録があります。

assumptions: Autonomous additive initial-value problem with sufficiently smooth subflows on a fixed finite time interval.
The stated global order requires stability and sufficiently small steps.
Use exact subflows or subsolvers with sufficient order and compatible boundaries; symmetric subsolvers are needed for time symmetry.
assumptions_ja: 自律的で加法的な初期値問題。固定した有限時間区間で部分流と解に十分な滑らかさがある。
表示した大域次数には安定性と十分小さい刻みが必要。
厳密流または必要な次数・境界整合性を持つ部分ソルバーを用いる。時間対称性には対称な部分ソルバーも必要。
legacy_method_records.units: h has time units; F and G have units of state/time. For linear systems hA and hB are dimensionless. The oscillator illustration is nondimensional.
legacy_method_records.units_ja: hは時間、FとGは状態/時間の単位。線形系ではhAとhBが無次元。教材の振動子は全変数を無次元化。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: None for the two-component ODE. PDEs need compatible stage boundary data; inhomogeneous or time-dependent boundaries can reduce order.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 2成分ODEに空間境界条件はない。PDEでは部分問題・段階の境界値を整合させる。非同次・時間依存境界では次数低下を確認。

limitations.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。
limitations.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope.

limitations.ja: 滑らかな固定問題だけの結果。要素・求積・代数ソルバーが異なるので、速度・計算量・汎用的優位性の比較ではありません。GLLの対角求積質量は一般の積の厳密な質量行列ではない。曲線格子・特異解・非圧縮流体・Nek5000/nekRS本体は未実行。
limitations.en: One smooth fixed problem only. Meshes, quadrature and algebraic solvers differ: no speed, complexity or universal-accuracy ranking. The diagonal GLL quadrature mass is not the exactly integrated mass of every product. No curved mesh, singular solution, incompressible flow or Nek5000/nekRS run.

metadata_review.level: Method-specific derivation and scoped dedicated fixed inputs; 25 tests and full independent ZIP rerun. Related external implementations reviewed from official documentation only.

depth_scope.ja: 単位正方形の正弦製造解をGLLスペクトル要素法と既存P1三角形FEMで解きます。自由未知数を揃えたh細分化と、固定要素数でのp=1〜6を分けて測ります。
depth_scope.en: Solve a sine manufactured solution on the unit square with GLL spectral elements and the existing triangle P1 FEM. Compare matched free-unknown counts under h refinement and p=1..6 at fixed elements.

summary.ja: 要素内の流束に界面補正を加える高次離散化の枠組み。1D周期移流のRadau補正と既存DGの一致・保存・収束を軽量例で確かめ、PyFRを関連実装として紹介。
summary.en: A high-order framework correcting element-local fluxes at interfaces. A small1D periodic-advection example checks Radau/DG agreement, conservation and convergence; PyFR is a related implementation.

legacy_method_records.code_mapping_scope: Dedicated sem-fr supplement; case-specific algorithms plus a shared experiment driver and test file. External PyFR/Nek implementations are documentation links, not executed software.

legacy_method_records.assumptions: Dimensionless u_t+u_x=0 on[0,1), periodic boundary, initial0.4+sin(2pi x), analytic0.4+sin(2pi(x-t)). Constant positive speed1 and uniform affine intervals.
legacy_method_records.assumptions_ja: 全て無次元。u_t+u_x=0、区間[0,1)、周期境界、初期値0.4+sin(2πx)。解析解は0.4+sin(2π(x−t))。一定の正速度1、均一なアフィン区間要素。
legacy_method_records.units: Dimensionless educational example.
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 無次元の教育用例。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Dimensionless u_t+u_x=0 on[0,1), periodic boundary, initial0.4+sin(2pi x), analytic0.4+sin(2pi(x-t)). Constant positive speed1 and uniform affine intervals.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: 全て無次元。u_t+u_x=0、区間[0,1)、周期境界、初期値0.4+sin(2πx)。解析解は0.4+sin(2π(x−t))。一定の正速度1、均一なアフィン区間要素。

limitations.ja: このRadau/Gauss・線形一定流束・アフィン要素の設定がDGに対応します。全FRと全DGの同値性、非線形流束・衝撃波・制限器・多次元FRは保証しません。hとΔtの同時細分化と行列指数による空間誤差を分け、行列指数を独立した空間PDEソルバーとは呼びません。PyFR本体は未実行。
limitations.en: DG correspondence is for these Radau/Gauss choices, a constant linear flux and affine elements. No all-FR/all-DG equivalence, nonlinear flux, shock, limiter or multidimensional FR claim. Distinguish coupled h/dt refinement from the exponential spatial result; the exponential is not an independent spatial PDE solver. PyFR itself is not run.

metadata_review.level: Method-specific derivation and scoped dedicated fixed inputs; 25 tests and full independent ZIP rerun. Related external implementations reviewed from official documentation only.

depth_scope.ja: 0.4+sin(2πx)をT=.25まで移流。Gauss点・Radau補正のFRと既存のmodal DGをp=1/2、8/16/32セルで実行し、誤差・質量・時間積分誤差を測ります。
depth_scope.en: Transport0.4+sin(2pi x) toT=.25. Execute Gauss-node/Radau FR and the existing modal DG for p=1/2 and8/16/32 cells; measure analytic error, mass and time-integration error.

name.ja: Q1有限要素法（曲線座標ベクトルBVP）
name.en: Q1 FEM for mapped-coordinate vector BVP

summary.ja: 極座標(r,θ)の双線形基底でCartesian速度2成分を近似し、円環の可変粘性応力発散BVPを解く。正確なrのJacobian、物理勾配、結合したひずみ弱形式を組み立てる。
summary.en: Approximate two Cartesian velocity components with bilinear(r,theta) basis functions for an annular variable-viscosity stress BVP. Assemble the exact polar Jacobian,physical gradients and coupled strain weak form.

legacy_method_records.code_mapping_scope: Supplemental annular-viscous-mms release only; no claim that the common P1 module implements Q1.

references.label: MFEM developers. Example2: Linear Elasticity.
references.scope: Example2 stress sigma=lambda div(u)I+mu(grad(u)+grad(u)^T), weak formulation and traction conventions inspected. Use lambda0 as a linear vector viscous BVP; manufactured fields are derived here. MFEM not executed or copied.

supports.ja: σ=λdiv(u)I+μ(∇u+∇uᵀ)のλ=0で応力弱形式を確認。本例のQ1写像と製造場は独自に導出し、MFEMは実行していません。
supports.en: Supports the lambda0 symmetric-stress weak form. The mapped Q1 discretization and MMS are independently derived; MFEM was not run.

verification.locator: Example2 governing stress,weak form and traction conventions; selected equations only.

assumptions: Bilinear basis in(r,theta) with exact polar geometry Jacobian r,1<=r<=2,periodic theta.
Unknowns are two Cartesian velocity components; lambda0 variable-mu linear stress-divergence BVP.
Physical-gradient transform and engineering-strain block weak form explicitly derived in references/README.md.
assumptions_ja: 1≤r≤2の円環、θ周期。基底は(r,θ)でQ1、正確な極座標Jacobian rを使う。
未知数はCartesian速度2成分。λ=0、μ=1+r²/5の線形応力発散BVP。
物理勾配とengineering strainの結合弱形式をreferences/README.mdで明示。
legacy_method_records.units: Dimensionless fixed annulus. In dimensional form traction has scale mu*U/L and body force mu*U/L².
legacy_method_records.units_ja: 固定円環は無次元。次元を与えるなら牽引力の尺度はμU/L、体積力はμU/L²。
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions: Zero Cartesian Dirichlet data on r1 and r2; periodic theta. Physical outward traction is measured,not prescribed.
legacy_method_records.boundary_conditions_ja: r1/r2でCartesian速度を零Dirichlet、θ周期。外向きの物理牽引力は測定し、境界値として課していない。

limitations.ja: 指定円環のmapped Q1ベクトルBVPだけ。P1、一般四辺形・軸r0・圧力/非圧縮拘束・非線形Navier–Stokesではない。Nr8/16/32,Nθ2Nrの固定検査を一般認証へ拡張しない。
limitations.en: Mapped Q1 vector BVP on this annulus only; not P1,general quadrilaterals,an r0 axis,pressure/incompressibility or nonlinear Navier–Stokes. FixedNr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr checks are not broad certification.

metadata_review.level: Actual mapped Q1 source and engineering-strain weak form independently inspected; numerical execution/receipts remain attached to the supplemental release.

depth_scope.ja: 円環の極座標Q1でCartesian2成分の可変粘性応力を結合。正確な曲線Jacobian、内外の物理牽引力、非零全境界力、仕事と製造解誤差を固定入力で比較します。
depth_scope.en: Mapped polarQ1 couples both Cartesian components of variable-viscosity stress. Fixed cases check exact curved geometry,inner/outer physical traction,nonzero net force,work and MMS errors.
